AI.conclusion: 论文提出并验证了一个面向异构 GPU 云中 SLO 约束 LLM 推理的秒级联合资源分配框架：MILP 精确模型提供最优性参照与约束定义，GH/AGH 通过 M1–M3 三个约束感知机制在构造过程中全程保持可行，并在需要频繁重优化的生产场景中给出近最优解。结论性启示有三点：(a) 最优性不等于鲁棒性——精确 MILP 的成本最小解因无余量在需求偏移下反而更差；(b) 联合可行性约束必须在同一分配循环内强制执行，否则分解式启发式会产出不可行或高罚金解；(c) 架构改进的价值大于重优化频率，滚动时域主要用于削峰。未来工作包括在规划层延迟模型中引入负载相关排队项、与 vLLM/DistServe 等具体服务引擎闭环集成、以及引入碳强度感知的档位成本。

title: Lightweight LLM Agent Memory with Small Language Models
summary: Although LLM agents can leverage tools for complex tasks, they still need memory to maintain cross-turn consistency and accumulate reusable information in long-horizon interactions. However, retrieval-based external memory systems incur low online overhead but suffer from unstable accuracy due to limited query construction and candidate filtering. In contrast, many systems use repeated large-model calls for online memory operations, improving accuracy but accumulating latency over long interactions. We propose LightMem, a lightweight memory system for better agent memory driven by Small Language Models (SLMs). LightMem modularizes memory retrieval, writing, and long-term consolidation, and separates online processing from offline consolidation to enable efficient memory invocation under bounded compute. We organize memory into short-term memory (STM) for immediate conversational context, mid-term memory (MTM) for reusable interaction summaries, and long-term memory (LTM) for consolidated knowledge, and uses user identifiers to support independent retrieval and incremental maintenance in multi-user settings. Online, LightMem operates under a fixed retrieval budget and selects memories via a two-stage procedure: vector-based coarse retrieval followed by semantic consistency re-ranking. Offline, it abstracts reusable interaction evidence and incrementally integrates it into LTM. Experiments show gains across model scales, with an average F1 improvement of about 2.5 on LoCoMo, more effective and low median latency (83 ms retrieval; 581 ms end-to-end).

AI.tldr: LightMem是一种由小型语言模型驱动的轻量级记忆系统，通过模块化设计将记忆操作分为在线处理和离线整合两部分，并采用三层记忆架构（短期/中期/长期）来解决LLM智能体在长程交互中的记忆问题。该系统在保持低延迟的同时提升了记忆准确性，在LoCoMo数据集上F1提升约2.5，检索延迟中位数仅83ms。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需要记忆来维持跨轮一致性并积累可复用信息，但现有方法存在权衡困境：基于检索的外部记忆系统在线开销低但准确性不稳定（受限于查询构建和候选过滤），而使用重复大模型调用虽能提高准确性但会随交互延长而累积延迟。因此需要一种能在有限计算资源下实现高效、准确记忆调用的方案。
AI.method: LightMem采用模块化设计，将记忆检索、写入和长期整合分离，并分离在线处理与离线整合。具体包括：（1）三层记忆架构：短期记忆（STM）处理即时对话上下文，中期记忆（MTM）存储可复用的交互摘要，长期记忆（LTM）存储整合后的知识；（2）使用用户标识符支持多用户场景下的独立检索和增量维护；（3）在线阶段采用固定检索预算，通过两阶段选择：基于向量的粗检索 + 语义一致性重排序；（4）离线阶段抽象可复用交互证据并增量整合至LTM。
AI.result: 实验表明LightMem在不同模型规模下均取得提升，在LoCoMo数据集上F1平均提升约2.5，检索延迟中位数仅83ms，端到端延迟581ms，实现了既高效又低延迟的记忆系统。
AI.conclusion: LightMem通过SLM驱动的轻量级设计成功平衡了记忆系统的准确性与效率，其模块化架构和三层记忆设计为长程交互场景下的智能体记忆问题提供了有效解决方案，具有良好的跨模型规模适用性。

title: HCRE: LLM-based Hierarchical Classification for Cross-Document Relation Extraction with a Prediction-then-Verification Strategy
summary: Cross-document relation extraction (RE) aims to identify relations between the head and tail entities located in different documents. Existing approaches typically adopt the paradigm of ``\textit{Small Language Model (SLM) + Classifier}''. However, the limited language understanding ability of SLMs hinders further improvement of their performance. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary study to explore the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cross-document RE. Despite their extensive parameters, our findings indicate that LLMs do not consistently surpass existing SLMs. Further analysis suggests that the underperformance is largely attributed to the challenges posed by the numerous predefined relations. To overcome this issue, we propose an LLM-based \underline{H}ierarchical \underline{C}lassification model for cross-document \underline{RE} (HCRE), which consists of two core components: 1) an LLM for relation prediction and 2) a \textit{hierarchical relation tree} derived from the predefined relation set. This tree enables the LLM to perform hierarchical classification, where the target relation is inferred level by level. Since the number of child nodes is much smaller than the size of the entire predefined relation set, the hierarchical relation tree significantly reduces the number of relation options that LLM needs to consider during inference. However, hierarchical classification introduces the risk of error propagation across levels. To mitigate this, we propose a \textit{prediction-then-verification} inference strategy that improves prediction reliability through multi-view verification at each level. Extensive experiments show that HCRE outperforms existing baselines, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨文档关系抽取任务，探索了大语言模型（LLM）的性能表现，发现LLM因预定义关系数量繁多而表现受限，进而提出基于层次分类的HCRE模型，通过构建层次关系树减少LLM需考虑的关系选项，并引入"预测-验证"推理策略降低错误传播风险，实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 跨文档关系抽取（Cross-document RE）旨在识别位于不同文档的头尾实体间关系。现有方法多采用"小语言模型（SLM）+分类器"范式，但SLM的语言理解能力有限制约了性能提升。研究团队初步探索了LLM在该任务上的表现，发现尽管参数量更大，LLM并未持续超越SLM，进一步分析表明其根本原因在于预定义关系数量过多带来的挑战。
AI.method: 提出HCRE模型，包含两个核心组件：1）基于LLM的关系预测模块；2）从预定义关系集构建的层次关系树。该树使LLM能够执行层次分类，逐层推断目标关系。由于子节点数量远小于整个预定义关系集的规模，层次关系树显著减少了推理时LLM需要考虑的关系选项数量。针对层次分类带来的错误传播风险，采用"预测-验证"推理策略，通过多视角验证提高每层预测的可靠性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HCRE优于现有基线方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 层次分类策略可有效缓解LLM在面对大量预定义关系时的选择困难，结合多视角验证机制能够控制错误传播风险，为LLM在跨文档关系抽取任务上的应用提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Cluster Attention for Graph Machine Learning
summary: Message Passing Neural Networks have recently become the most popular approach to graph machine learning tasks; however, their receptive field is limited by the number of message passing layers. To increase the receptive field, Graph Transformers with global attention have been proposed; however, global attention does not take into account the graph topology and thus lacks graph-structure-based inductive biases, which are typically very important for graph machine learning tasks. In this work, we propose an alternative approach: cluster attention (CLATT). We divide graph nodes into clusters with off-the-shelf graph community detection algorithms and let each node attend to all other nodes in each cluster. CLATT provides large receptive fields while still having strong graph-structure-based inductive biases. We show that augmenting Message Passing Neural Networks or Graph Transformers with CLATT significantly improves their performance on a wide range of graph datasets including datasets from the recently introduced GraphLand benchmark representing real-world applications of graph machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"簇注意力"（Cluster Attention, CLATT）：先用现成的社区检测算法把图节点划分成若干簇，再让每个节点在其所属簇内的所有节点间做注意力计算。CLATT 是介于消息传递（仅邻居可交互）与全局注意力（全对全交互）之间的"中间地带"，既提供长程交互能力，又保留了基于图结构的强归纳偏置。实验表明，将 CLATT 增广到 GCN、GraphSAGE、Local Graph Transformer 以及两种 Global Graph Transformer 上，在 12 个真实数据集（含 GraphLand 基准）上几乎全面提升性能；CLATT 对 GGT 的提升尤为显著（可达 10+ 个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）的感受野受限于消息传递层数，难以捕捉长程依赖；图 Transformer（GGT）虽具备全局感受野，但完全忽略图拓扑，缺乏图结构归纳偏置，而这类偏置在图机器学习任务中通常非常关键。作者观察到许多真实网络具有明显的社区/簇结构（cluster structure），因此希望把图的社区划分信息作为归纳偏置注入模型：在保持图结构约束的前提下实现比 MPNN 更长程的信息交换，从而在两类架构之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1）CLATT 定义：对有序聚类集合 C 的每个聚类 C，在簇内用标准多头缩放点积注意力（softmax 归一化于簇内）计算节点表示，输出按聚类维度拼接（y_i ∈ R^{d|C|}）；CLATT 输出再与消息传递输出或全局注意力输出拼接，经可学习线性层降回维度 d。2）聚类算法选择：按"高效"与"结果差异显著"两条准则选 4 种——Leiden 算法（CPM 目标，无分辨率极限）、Zhang & Peixoto 的 Bayesian planted partition model、Peixoto 的层级统计聚类（可检测 disassortative 簇，取最小非平凡簇层级）、以及在辅助 ResMLP 表征上做 k-means（特征相似性基线）；用 CC 相似度矩阵验证彼此差异。3）聚类组合作为超参：先用 LGT 对每种聚类单独训练 4 次，按验证集筛选有益聚类并在主训练中联合使用。4）实现：不用补边，而是将节点表征转为 num_clusters × max_cluster_size × hidden_dim 的填充张量，在 max_cluster_size 维做稠密注意力并用 mask 屏蔽 padding，配合 SDPA/FlashAttention、JIT 编译及 ragged/jagged 张量。5）实验设置：12 个数据集（GraphLand 7 个 + lastfm-asia/facebook + questions + amazon-ratings-5core + 新构建 amazon-ratings-full），全批训练，3 层、隐藏维 512、Adam、1000 步（amazon-ratings-5core 3000 步），10 个随机种子（pokec-regions 5 个），学习率/ dropout 网格搜索；CLATT 丢弃簇大小 <4 或 >512 的簇。附录 A 分析按注意力概率加权的平均注意距离分布。
AI.result: CLATT 在几乎所有"基线 vs +CLATT"配对中提升性能，唯一例外是 GraphSAGE 在 amazon-ratings-5core 上（未加 CLATT 略优）。pokec-regions 上 GCN/GraphSAGE 分别提升超过 13 和 10 个百分点；hm-categories 上 GGT-DW/GGT-Lap 分别提升超过 13 和 15 个百分点。提升同时覆盖同配与非同配、稠密与稀疏图（如 city-roads 聚集系数≈0 仍有显著收益）。多聚类联合在 50% 数据集上有效；Leiden 被选中率最高（75%），基于特征的 k-means 仅在 1 个数据集被选中，说明结构型聚类更有效。效率方面：pokec-regions（160 万节点）上 LGT-CLATT 约半小时完成训练，而 GGT 单次训练约需 65 小时（TL 超时）。注意力距离分析显示：CLATT 的平均注意距离显著大于局部注意（常超出 3 层 MPNN 的可达范围），但显著小于全局注意（如 lastfm-asia 中 CLATT 距离 0.75 分位低于全局注意 0.05 分位），说明全局注意难以聚焦于近邻节点，CLATT 弥补了这一缺陷。附录 D 还发现 amazon-ratings-full 上提升幅度小于 5-core 版本，提示 5-core 的团簇式结构对 CLATT 特别有利。
AI.conclusion: CLATT 是一种简单且通用的"结构感知的注意力"机制：它以社区检测的簇为注意力作用域，在保留强图结构归纳偏置的同时提供长程交互，可作为插件增强 MPNN 与 GGT。作者预期其有效性取决于图中是否存在有意义的簇结构，因而对规则网格类图可能无益；代码已开源（github.com/OlegPlatonov/cluster-attention）。总体而言，MPNN 仍普遍优于 GGT，而 CLATT 对 GGT 帮助更大，可部分缩小二者差距。

title: Agentivism: a learning theory for the age of artificial intelligence
summary: Learning theories have historically changed when the conditions of learning evolved. Generative and agentic AI create a new condition by allowing learners to delegate explanation, writing, problem solving, and other cognitive work to systems that can generate, recommend, and sometimes act on the learner's behalf. This creates a fundamental challenge for learning theory: successful performance can no longer be assumed to indicate learning. Learners may complete tasks effectively with AI support while developing less understanding, weaker judgment, and limited transferable capability. We argue that this problem is not fully captured by existing learning theories. Behaviourism, cognitivism, constructivism, and connectivism remain important, but they do not directly explain when AI-assisted performance becomes durable human capability. We propose Agentivism, a learning theory for human-AI interaction. Agentivism defines learning as durable growth in human capability through selective delegation to AI, epistemic monitoring and verification of AI contributions, reconstructive internalization of AI-assisted outputs, and transfer under reduced support. The importance of Agentivism lies in explaining how learning remains possible when intelligent delegation is easy and human-AI interaction is becoming a persistent and expanding part of human learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「Agentivism（能动者主义）」，作为面向生成式与智能体式AI时代的中层学习理论。作者认为AI让「表现」与「学习」彻底分离：学习者可在AI支持下高效完成任务，却未获得理解、判断力与可迁移能力。经典理论（行为主义、认知主义、建构主义、连接主义）各有贡献但均无法回答「智能委托变易之后，何时AI辅助表现才转化为持久的人类能力」。Agentivism将学习定义为：通过选择性委托、认知监控与验证、建构性内化，以及在减少支持条件下的迁移，而实现的人类能力的持久增长。
AI.motivation: 生成式与智能体式AI引入了新的学习条件：学习者可以把解释、写作、问题解决等认知劳动委托给能生成、推荐甚至代为行动的系统。核心困难是「成功表现不再等于学习」——学习者可能借助AI高效完成任务，却发展出更少的理解、更弱的判断和有限的迁移能力。既有学习理论各自解释了部分现象：行为主义解释AI为何因即时反馈、流畅性和省力而具有行为强化性；认知主义解释认知卸载与心理加工变化（学习感与实际学习背离、认知负荷下降但推理质量更弱）；建构主义强调对话、解释、意义建构与参与；连接主义强调知识分布于人与工具网络。但这些理论都未直接处理当网络节点本身具备生成性、说服性与部分自主性时，「委托式表现如何转为持久能力」这一新的解释问题，且缺乏以学习过程（而非最终产物）为核心的实证路径。
AI.method: 采用Merton意义上的中层概念理论建构方式：先做概念界定（Box 1术语表：生成式AI、智能体AI、辅助性表现、持久人类能力、委托、验证、建构性内化、减少支持下的迁移），再以文献与实证证据逐条检验四大经典理论的解释力与盲区（Table 1），进而指出AI带来的四项条件变化——知识可动员化、能动性动态分配、表现与学习更易分离、认识论信任与多样性从边缘走向中心——并据此提出Agentivism的四个核心机制（Fig.1）：委托式能动性、认知监控与验证、建构性内化、减少支持下的迁移。作者进一步说明其与Bandura社会认知理论（直接/代理/集体能动性）、自我调节与混合人机调节研究、建构主义、连接主义、认知主义、行为主义的关系与差别（重组而非取代），并提出P1–P6六条可检验命题（Fig.2）：(1)保留问题框架、准则设定与论证责任的设计带来更强学习；(2)要求验证、比对来源、说明采纳理由的设计改善延迟迁移，即使降低便利性；(3)大量重述、修改、转化AI材料者保留性理解更强；(4)当监控与重构最少时，即时AI辅助表现与后续独立表现仅弱相关；(5)交互过程指标（提示轨迹、修订序列、证据核查、解释质量）比最终产物质量更能预测后续学习；(6)反复低摩擦委托而无重构将导致自我能力校准变差与依赖上升。
AI.result: 论文给出的是一个理论框架而非实证检验结果：Agentivism被定位为中层机制性概念理论，识别核心机制、阐明其关系并生成可检验命题家族，但不声称所有AI参与的学习遵循单一固定序列，也未给出形式化计算模型或单一量化指标。作者指出，现有实证证据（AI辅助写作产出更强但知识与独立修订无相应增益、ChatGPT支持的探究任务认知负荷更低但推理更浅、认知强迫干预可降低过度依赖、AI辅导若显式脚手架推理步骤则同时支持即时表现与迁移）均与该框架相容，且经典理论的功能被重新定位——行为主义回答「强化」，认知主义回答「卸载与加工」，建构主义回答「参与与意义」，连接主义回答「分布」，Agentivism则专门回答「委托的分配、验证、重构与迁移」。作者主张研究应放弃把「是否使用AI」当作单一处理条件，转而测量交互过程中的委托、监控、修订与低支持表现，并把延迟解释、陌生任务适应与独立表现作为更核心的因变量；评估上需引入过程性/轨迹性证据以区分辅助表现与持久能力。
AI.conclusion: Agentivism的核心主张是：AI时代的学习应被理解为「通过选择性委托、批判性验证与对AI辅助表现的重建性内化而实现的人类能力的持久增长」，其价值在于使「辅助性表现」与「持久人类学习」的区分在概念上明确化、实证上可操作化、教育上具有后果。理论上它不否定经典学习理论，而是围绕新条件重组其洞见；实践上强调教学与评估应把学习者保留为问题框架者、准则设定者、评价者与解释者，而非被流畅输出替代的接受者。局限与开放问题有三点：一是核心构念的操作化与测量模型（需要轨迹数据、修订史、话语分析、延迟测评与混合方法）；二是边界条件（新手写作与高级编程/科学探究/专业决策中「有效委托」定义不同，先备知识、动机与自我调节能力差异，以及主动提示、自适应脚手架、多智能体评估、更自主执行等支持形态）；三是时间尺度（现有证据多来自短期任务，纵向研究对验证「反复低摩擦委托会侵蚀独立能力」这一预测尤为关键）。作者最终将其定位为一项必要的概念推进而非完成的学说，并以此界定后续研究议程。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
summary:
Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objective families rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address.
  This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary learning regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories, and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes behavior across stages and model transitions.
  This perspective yields a unified reading of major paradigms. SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping, whereas preference-based methods are usually off-policy reshaping. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, though under stronger guidance it can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often best understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions.
  Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress in LLM post-training increasingly depends on coordinated system design rather than any single dominant objective.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述（survey），提出用"轨迹来源（trajectory provenance）"作为LLM后训练的统一顶层组织轴，将后训练划分为离策略学习（外部提供轨迹）与在策略学习（学习者自生成rollout）两大范式；并以"监督接口"为次级描述层，以"有效支撑扩展（effective support expansion）"、"策略重塑（policy reshaping）"和"行为巩固（behavioral consolidation）"三类分布级/系统级功能角色来统一解释SFT、偏好优化、RLHF/RLVR、过程监督与验证器引导、蒸馏及混合流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有文献多按历史标签或目标族（指令微调、偏好优化、RLHF、RLVR、蒸馏等）碎片化组织，掩盖了这些方法其实是"对同一对象——由轨迹分布诱导的模型行为——的不同干预方式"。同时，越来越多强系统采用多阶段流水线而非单一目标，因此需要一个能回答"在何处学习、信号如何附着、行为如何改变"的分析框架，以诊断瓶颈并推理阶段组成。
AI.method: 1) 形式基础：将自回归LM视为轨迹上的策略π_θ(y|x)，引入归一化状态-动作占据测度d(s,a)与状态占据d(s)，区分前缀可达性（prefix reachability）与状态条件动作可用性（state-conditional action availability）；2) 定义有效支撑E_ε={ (s,a): d(s,a)≥ε }，支撑扩展判据E_ε(π_1)\E_ε(π_0)≠∅，重塑判据为主效应可由共享支撑C_ε=E_ε(π_0)∩E_ε(π_1)内的概率再分配解释，损耗A_ε=E_ε(π_0)\E_ε(π_1)作为诊断互补项；3) 三层框架：轨迹来源（顶层）→监督接口（token目标/成对偏好/奖励信号/验证器与过程反馈/教师引导目标）→功能角色；4) 按该框架系统评述离策略子族（SFT、离线偏好优化、离策略教师引导迁移）与在策略子族（RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR、在线偏好优化、过程监督与验证器引导、迭代自我改进、在策略教师引导迁移），并给出混合流水线的阶段组成模式、交接风险与跨范式比较（表格1–8）；5) 提出操作启发式判定规则与六个开放问题簇。
AI.result: 得到一套统一的分析语言与比较矩阵：SFT依监督覆盖度可在支撑扩展与策略重塑间切换；离线偏好优化通常为离策略重塑（优势是效率高，盲点是学习者状态失配）；在线偏好优化是在策略重塑的过渡形态；RLHF/RLVR通常为学习者状态重塑，在强引导（自提示、脚手架、结构化模板）下可实现选择性扩展，但受评估器失配、奖励黑客与成本/稳定性制约；过程监督属细粒度学习者状态重塑；蒸馏被重定义为巩固（保留、迁移、摊销、压缩）而非仅压缩，并可实例化于两种来源中；混合流水线被刻画为"扩展→重塑→巩固"的三阶段协同系统，而非第三个范式。识别出主要失效模式：阶段失配、阶段过渡校准不当、跨阶段梯度干扰、迁移衰减/保持失败、评估器不一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM后训练应被视为"行为系统设计"问题而非单一目标竞赛；进展取决于瓶颈诊断（有效支撑缺失 vs. 学习者状态内选择不佳 vs. 跨阶段保持不足）、监督接口的原理性选择、以及阶段组成与行为巩固的协调。作者明确声明该框架是比较性分析透镜而非规范性的度量方案或机制理论，各角色归属为上下文依赖的"主导性分析判定"；未来需发展可操作的有效支撑度量、迁移本体学、保持/遗忘与交接保真度的评估协议，以及解释扩展—重塑—巩固差异的机制性研究。

title: Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models
summary: Data mixing strategy is essential for large language model (LLM) training. Empirical evidence shows that inappropriate strategies can significantly reduce generalization. Although recent methods have improved empirical performance, several fundamental questions remain open: what constitutes a domain, whether human and model perceptions of domains are aligned, and how domain weighting influences generalization. We address these questions by establishing formal connections between gradient dynamics and domain distributions, offering a theoretical framework that clarifies the role of domains in training dynamics. Building on this analysis, we introduce DoGraph, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as a graph-constrained optimization problem. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 models of varying scales demonstrate that DoGraph consistently achieves competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型训练中的数据混合策略问题，提出通过建立梯度动态与领域分布之间的形式化联系来理解领域在训练中的作用，并基于此开发了DoGraph框架，将数据调度问题形式化为图约束优化问题。
AI.motivation: 当前数据混合策略存在三个核心问题未解决：1）领域的定义不明确；2）人类感知的领域与模型感知的领域是否对齐；3）领域权重如何影响模型泛化能力。不恰当的策略会显著降低模型泛化性能。
AI.method: 1）建立梯度动态与领域分布之间的形式化联系，提供理论框架；2）提出DoGraph重加权框架，将数据调度建模为图约束优化问题；3）在不同规模的GPT-2模型上进行广泛实验验证。
AI.result: DoGraph在各种规模的GPT-2模型上均表现出一致的竞争力，性能优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论框架澄清了领域在训练动态中的作用，为数据混合策略的设计提供了坚实的理论基础，DoGraph框架能有效提升模型泛化性能。

title: Learning Markov Processes as Sum-of-Square Forms for Analytical Belief Propagation
comment: Twenty-Ninth Annual Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2026)
summary: Harnessing the predictive capability of Markov process models requires propagating probability density functions (beliefs) through the model. For many existing models however, belief propagation is analytically infeasible, requiring approximation or sampling to generate predictions. This paper proposes a functional modeling framework leveraging sparse Sum-of-Squares (SoS) forms for valid (conditional) density estimation. We study the theoretical restrictions of modeling conditional densities using the SoS form, and propose a novel functional form for addressing such limitations. The proposed architecture enables generalized simultaneous learning of basis functions and coefficients, while preserving analytical belief propagation. In addition, we propose a training method that allows for exact adherence to the normalization and non-negativity constraints. Our results show that the proposed method achieves accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art approaches while requiring significantly less memory in low-dimensional spaces, and it further scales to 12D systems when existing methods fail beyond 2D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于稀疏平方和(SoS)形式函数的建模框架，用于在马尔可夫过程模型中进行有效的（条件）密度估计。框架在保持解析信念传播的同时解决了SoS形式的理论限制，并通过新型训练方法确保归一化和非负性约束的严格遵守。实验表明该方法在低维空间内存需求显著低于现有方法，并可扩展至12维系统。
AI.motivation: 马尔可夫过程模型的预测能力需要通过信念传播来实现，但现有模型中信念传播在解析上往往不可行，通常需要近似或采样方法来生成预测，这在计算效率和精度上都存在局限性。
AI.method: 1. 提出稀疏SoS形式的函数建模框架用于有效的条件密度估计；2. 研究了使用SoS形式建模条件密度的理论限制，并提出新型函数形式加以解决；3. 框架支持基函数和系数的联合学习，同时保持解析信念传播能力；4. 提出确保归一化和非负性约束严格遵守的训练方法。
AI.result: 该方法在低维空间中达到与先进方法相当的精度，但内存需求显著降低；当现有方法在2维以上即失效时，该方法成功扩展至12维系统。
AI.conclusion: 基于稀疏SoS形式的函数建模框架为马尔可夫过程的解析信念传播提供了一条可行路径，在计算效率和可扩展性方面展现出明显优势，特别是在高维系统上的突破性表现使其具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Silencing the Guardrails: Inference-Time Jailbreaking via Dynamic Contextual Representation Ablation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety constraints. Existing strategies, ranging from heuristic prompt engineering to computationally intensive optimization, often face significant trade-offs between effectiveness and efficiency. In this work, we propose Contextual Representation Ablation (CRA), a novel inference-time intervention framework designed to dynamically silence model guardrails. Predicated on the geometric insight that refusal behaviors are mediated by specific low-rank subspaces within the model's hidden states, CRA identifies and suppresses these refusal-inducing activation patterns during decoding without requiring expensive parameter updates or training. Empirical evaluation across multiple safety-aligned open-source LLMs demonstrates that CRA significantly outperforms baselines. These results expose the intrinsic fragility of current alignment mechanisms, revealing that safety constraints can be surgically ablated from internal representations, and underscore the urgent need for more robust defenses that secure the model's latent space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRA（Contextual Representation Ablation），一种推理时干预框架，通过识别并抑制LLM隐藏状态中与拒绝行为相关的低秩子空间，无需训练或参数更新即可绕过模型安全约束，暴露了现有对齐机制的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）虽已展现强大能力，但仍易受越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）影响。现有防御策略在有效性与效率之间存在显著权衡：启发式提示工程效果有限，而计算密集的优化方法代价高昂。因此需要一种既能有效绕过安全机制又具备高效性的新方案。
AI.method: CRA基于几何洞察：拒绝行为由模型隐藏状态中的特定低秩子空间介导。方法核心是在解码过程中动态识别并抑制这些拒绝诱导的激活模式，无需昂贵的参数更新或训练过程。具体包括：(1) 识别隐藏状态中与拒绝行为相关的低秩子空间；(2) 在推理时对这些子空间进行消融（ablation）操作；(3) 通过解码干预绕过安全约束。
AI.result: 在多个安全对齐的开源LLM上的实验表明，CRA显著优于基线方法。证明了当前对齐机制的内在脆弱性：安全约束可被从内部表示中精确切除。
AI.conclusion: CRA揭示了现有LLM安全对齐机制的致命弱点——仅需推理时干预而无须任何参数修改即可绕过防护。这强调了开发更鲁棒防御的紧迫性，需从模型潜在空间层面构建安全保障，而非依赖表面层的行为约束。

title: AtomEval: Atomic Evaluation of Adversarial Claims in Fact Verification
summary: Adversarial claim rewriting is widely used to test fact-checking systems, but standard metrics fail to capture truth-conditional consistency and often label semantically corrupted rewrites as successful. We introduce AtomEval, a validity-aware evaluation framework that decomposes claims into subject-relation-object-modifier (SROM) atoms and scores adversarial rewrites with Atomic Validity Scoring (AVS), enabling detection of factual corruption beyond surface similarity. Experiments on the FEVER dataset across representative attack strategies and LLM generators show that AtomEval provides more reliable evaluation signals in our experiments. Using AtomEval, we further analyze LLM-based adversarial generators and observe that stronger models do not necessarily produce more effective adversarial claims under validity-aware evaluation, highlighting previously overlooked limitations in current adversarial evaluation practices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AtomEval评估框架，通过将声明分解为SROM原子结构并使用原子有效性评分（AVS）来评估对抗性重写，解决了现有指标无法检测语义退化的问题。实验表明，更强的LLM模型在有效性感知评估下并不一定产生更有效的对抗性声明。
AI.motivation: 当前对抗性声明重写评估存在关键缺陷：标准指标（如表面相似度）无法捕捉真值条件一致性，常将语义受损的重写误判为成功。这导致对事实核查系统的攻击评估不准确，且忽视了对抗性生成器能力的真实局限性。
AI.method: 1）提出AtomEval框架，将声明分解为subject-relation-object-modifier（SROM）原子结构；2）设计Atomic Validity Scoring（AVS）方法评估对抗重写的有效性；3）在FEVER数据集上测试多种攻击策略和LLM生成器。
AI.result: AtomEval在检测事实腐败方面比表面相似度指标更可靠。更重要的是，有效性感知评估揭示了一个反直觉现象：更强的LLM模型（如GPT-4等）并不一定产生更有效的对抗性声明。
AI.conclusion: AtomEval为对抗性评估提供了更可靠的信号，揭示了当前对抗性评估实践中被忽视的局限性。未来研究应采用真值条件感知的评估方法，而非仅依赖表面相似度。

title: Validated Synthetic Patient Generation for Small Longitudinal Cohorts: Coagulation Dynamics Across Pregnancy
summary: Small longitudinal clinical cohorts, common in maternal health, rare diseases, and early-phase trials, limit computational modeling: too few patients to train reliable models, yet too costly and slow to expand through additional enrollment. We present multiplicity-weighted Stochastic Attention (SA), a generative framework based on modern Hopfield network theory that addresses this gap. SA embeds real patient profiles as memory patterns in a continuous energy landscape and generates novel synthetic patients via Langevin dynamics that interpolate between stored patterns while preserving the geometry of the original cohort. Per-pattern multiplicity weights enable targeted amplification of rare clinical subgroups at inference time without retraining. We applied SA to a longitudinal coagulation dataset from 23 pregnant patients spanning 72 biochemical features across 3 visits (pre-pregnancy baseline, first trimester, and third trimester), including rare subgroups such as polycystic ovary syndrome and preeclampsia. Synthetic patients generated by SA were statistically, structurally, and mechanistically indistinguishable from their real counterparts across multiple independent validation tests, including an ordinary differential equation model of the coagulation cascade. A downstream utility test further showed that a mechanistic model calibrated entirely on synthetic patients predicted held-out real patient outcomes as well as one calibrated on real data. These results demonstrate that SA can produce clinically useful synthetic cohorts from very small longitudinal datasets, enabling data-augmented modeling in small-cohort settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出重数加权随机注意力（Multiplicity-weighted Stochastic Attention, SA）——一种基于现代 Hopfield 网络理论的生成式框架，用于在极小纵向队列（K=23 例患者、72 项指标×3 次访视 = 216 维）上合成生理学可信的纵向患者画像。SA 将真实患者档案作为"记忆图样"嵌入连续能量景观，通过带多重性权重（multiplicity weights）的 Langevin 动力学生成合成患者；合成队列在边缘分布（合并中位 MRE 1.2%）、跨访视协方差结构、罕见亚组条件生成（PCOS n=3、妊娠期子痫前期 n=5）以及机制一致性（独立设定的 BZ2012 凝血级联 ODE 模型，cloud overlap 0.83–0.92，KS 检验 p>0.30）上与真实队列高度吻合；用合成患者标定的机制模型预测留出真实患者 TGA 的表现与真实标定相当（误差比 0.94）。结论为"概念验证"级别：可支持假设生成与工作流测试，但未增加独立临床证据，且存在高成员推断风险（AUC 0.97）与负值/极端值缺失等局限。
AI.motivation: 小样本纵向临床队列（母体健康、罕见病、早期临床试验）中，特征数 p 常超过样本数 n（本文 K=23、216 维），属 n
AI.method: 方法（Julia v1.12 实现）：①数据——UVM 前瞻队列 153 条记录/约 50 人，剔除缺失>30% 列并保留三次访视齐全者，得 K=23 例 × 72 项指标 × 3 次访视（孕前基线、孕早期末、孕中三期末），含 PCOS 3 例、既往 PE 6 例、期间新发 PE 5 例；72 项涵盖激素、凝血因子/抑制物、纤溶标志物、4 种起始条件下的 TGA 参数、ROTEM 黏弹性参数。②SA 生成管线——将每位患者 3 次访视拼接为 216 维向量 → 标准化 → PCA 保留 95% 方差（d_PCA=18）→ 记录并归一化各图样（单位范数）→ 由"注意力熵曲线对 log β 的最负二阶导数"规则定 β*≈2.94（随机图样尺度 √d≈4.24 作参考）→ 每个合成患者用独立 ULA 链（α=0.01，T=2000 步，初始化于随机存储图样附近）采样 → 方向-幅值分解：方向从 SA 得到，幅值 s 从 23 个真实 PCA 范数的经验分布抽取并重标定 → 逆 PCA + 去标准化 → 拆回三个访视记录。③能量与分布——加权 Hopfield 能量 E_r(ξ)=½‖ξ‖²−(1/β)log Σ r_k exp(β m_kᵀξ)，其诱导分布可解析地写成各向同性高斯混合 π_r(ξ)=Σ q_k N(m_k, β⁻¹I)，q_k ∝ r_k exp(β‖m_k‖²/2)，单位范数下即 q_k=r_k/Σr_j；重数权重 ρ 通过 softmax 的 log r 偏置进入，仅在推断期生效（ρ→∞ 退化为硬子集策展，ρ=1 为无条件生成），目标子群分量概率 f_target=0.80（PCOS ρ≈26.7，K_eff≈4.6；DPE ρ≈14.4，K_eff≈7.7）。④基线——Ledoit–Wolf 正则化 MVN（216 维）、CTGAN/TVAE（90 条逐访视记录）、同 18 维 PCA 空间的 PCA+GMM（两成分对角协方差）、PCA+KDE、PCA+kNN、PCA+高斯 copula 消融。⑤四层验证——边缘合理性（MRE、KS、新颖度 1−max cos、最近邻距离）；联合结构（216×216 相关矩阵残差、协方差特征谱、逐访视 PCA 投影）；条件结构（三亚组 100 例生成 + 描述性 bootstrap Mann–Whitney 诊断）；机制一致性（58 方程/64 速率常数的 BZ2012 ODE 模型，仅在真实 V1 患者群体水平标定 5 个 k_cat（prothrombinase、intrinsic/extrinsic tenase、PC 激活、mIIa→IIa），其余 59 个取文献值，TF-only 与 TF+TM 两种条件共 738 次仿真，指标为"云重叠"=合成预测/实测比值落在真实 5–95 分位区间内的比例，并作双样本 KS 检验与 Spearman 相关）。⑥下游效用——分别用 100 例合成 V1 与 23 例真实 V1 标定 5 个速率常数（有界 Nelder–Mead、11 次随机重启），在留出的真实 V2/V3 TGA 上比较中位相对误差。⑦稳健性——已知协方差的低秩高斯模拟（n=8–80、p=30–216、r=3/5/10）、临床队列子采样（n=20/15/10/8，各 10 次）、S 形曲线非线性基准（曲率 c=0–2）。⑧隐私——40 次随机划分（15 存储/8 留出），以到最近合成样本的距离做成员推断 AUC；并比较锚点初始化、球面初始化、池化 ULA、MALA 及解析直接采样（避免马尔可夫链）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 边缘层面，216 个特征-访视条目的合并中位 MRE 为 1.2%（95% bootstrap CI 1.0–1.6%），193/216（89%）低于 5%；纤维蛋白原<1%、FVIII 与 FII<2%、AT<3%；CTGAN 中位 MRE≈19%（模式崩塌），TVAE 在 3000 轮达 1.8% 但基于逐访视行、无法建模跨访视协方差与条件生成。(2) 新颖度 0.50，合成-真实最近邻距离 6.14 对真实-真实 6.87（比值 0.89），说明非简单复制。(3) 生理关系与轨迹保持：AT 与峰值凝血酶负相关、FVIII 与峰值正相关、FII/AT 与 ETP 关系正确；纤维蛋白原、FVIII、vWF 随孕周单调升高，AT 先降后部分回升，置信带重叠。(4) 跨访视结构：SA 保留 216×216 相关矩阵的 3×3 分块结构与跨访视依赖，残差小且无结构；MVN 残差平滑，源于 Ledoit–Wolf 在 194 个零空间维度注入伪方差，PCA 投影弥散更大；真实协方差秩为 22，SA 在第 18 主成分截断。(5) PCA 空间消融：两成分 GMM 与 copula 的 MRE（1.1%、1.3%）与机制重叠（0.92、0.93）也接近 SA（1.2%、0.90），说明这些指标并非 SA 独有；但 SA 的跨访视相关误差更大（0.64 对 0.42），无生成器在所有指标上最优。(6) 机制一致性：TF-only 云重叠 0.83（ETP）–0.92（T.Peak），KS D=0.081–0.123 全部 p>0.30；TF+TM 重叠 0.88–0.92（模型对蛋白 C 通路过度校正，峰值约 0.5×，真实与合成同样表现）；Spearman 相关 ETP 真实 ρ≈0.6–0.8、合成 ρ≈0.6–0.65，其余特征弱，符合 5 参数群体标定的局限。(7) 条件生成：PCOS（FVIII、vWF 升高）与新发 PE（α2-AP、FIX 升高）的组间秩序在 8 个特征上全部保持；24 个特征-条件对中 20 对（83%）在≥90% 的 bootstrap 重复中未检出差异（中位 98.6%），未达标的 4 对均为最小亚组的高方差特征（FIX、纤溶酶原）；但 K_eff 仅 4.6/7.7，信号仍源自 3 例与 5 例真实患者，不能当作独立样本量。(8) 下游效用：合成标定模型在留出真实 V2/V3 上五个特征的中位相对误差低 2–10%，总误差比 0.94，属同队列一致性检验。(9) 稳健性：已知协方差模拟中 SA 在 39 个 n
AI.conclusion: 重数加权 SA 能从 23 例患者的极小纵向队列生成低边缘误差、保留跨访视协方差、复现稀有亚组特征模式、并与同队列标定的凝血 ODE 模型保持一致的纵向合成画像；用合成画像标定的机制模型预测留出真实患者 TGA 与真实标定相当（误差比 0.94），直接解析采样复现了 Langevin 采样的保真度与成员推断结果。作者明确界定结论为概念验证：机制模型在同一队列上标定，故为"同队列一致性"而非独立生物学验证；机理检查仅覆盖凝血生成，未覆盖纤溶与黏弹性特征；未在第二个临床队列上检验泛化性；线性 PCA 表征在强曲率数据上退化（凸包与极端值信息不足，K_eff≠独立样本量）；管线要求各患者检测项目与访视时间完全对齐，不支持缺失/不规则访视；生成画像存在成员推断风险（AUC 0.97）与负激素值问题，需正向变量变换或受约束解码。结论是可用于假设生成、机制标定探索与工作流测试，不能用于估计极端风险，也不构成超越源队列的临床证据。

title: SPARD: Self-Paced Curriculum for RL Alignment via Integrating Reward Dynamics and Data Utility
summary: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting the focus from single, verifiable tasks toward complex, open-ended real-world scenarios, imposing significant challenges on the post-training phase. In these settings, the scale and complexity of reward systems have grown significantly, transitioning toward multi-objective formulations that encompass a comprehensive spectrum of model capabilities and application contexts. However, traditional methods typically rely on fixed reward weights, ignoring non-stationary learning dynamics and struggling with data heterogeneity across dimensions. To address these issues, we propose SPARD, a framework that establishes an automated, self-paced curriculum by perceiving learning progress to dynamically adjust multi-objective reward weights and data importance, thereby synchronizing learning intent with data utility for optimal performance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPARD significantly enhances model capabilities across all domains.

AI.tldr: SPARD提出了一种基于自步课程的自动化多目标奖励权重和数据重要性动态调整框架，用于大语言模型后训练阶段，以解决传统方法使用固定权重无法适应非平稳学习动态的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM应用场景的复杂化，奖励系统从单一目标扩展到多目标 formulation，但传统方法依赖固定奖励权重，忽视了学习过程中的非平稳动态以及跨维度数据异质性问题，导致难以在复杂真实场景中实现最优性能。
AI.method: SPARD框架通过感知学习进度（learning progress）建立自步课程机制，动态调整多目标奖励权重和数据重要性，实现学习意图与数据效用的同步优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SPARD在所有领域均显著提升了模型能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自动化自步课程方法有效解决了多目标强化学习中权重固定的局限性，为LLM后训练提供了一种更具适应性和高效性的训练范式。

title: Kathleen: Oscillator-Based Byte-Level Text Classification Without Tokenization or Attention
summary: We present Kathleen, a text classification architecture that operates directly on raw UTF-8 bytes using frequency-domain processing -- requiring no tokenizer, no attention mechanism, and only 733K parameters. Kathleen introduces three novel components: (1) RecurrentOscillatorBanks -- damped sinusoid convolutions with temporal memory for O(L) sequence processing; (2) an FFT-Rotate Wavetable Encoder that maps all 256 byte values using a single learnable vector (256 floats), replacing conventional embedding tables (65K parameters) while improving accuracy; (3) PhaseHarmonics -- a sinusoidal non-linearity with just 6 learnable phase parameters that our ablation identifies as the single most impactful component (+2.6% accuracy, <0.001% of model parameters). Through comprehensive ablation of a 1.8M-parameter predecessor, we show that frequency-domain components systematically outperform complex cognitive architectures: removing a 560K-parameter bio-inspired framework costs only -0.2%, while removing the 6-parameter PhaseHarmonics costs -2.6%. The resulting Kathleen-Clean achieves 88.6% on IMDB, 92.3% on AG News, and 83.3% on SST-2 -- outperforming a tokenized counterpart with 16x more parameters on IMDB (+1.6%) and AG News (+2.1%). Kathleen processes sequences in O(L) time and memory, enabling byte-level operation at sequence lengths where O(L^2) Transformers exhaust GPU memory.

AI.tldr: Kathleen是一个直接在原始UTF-8字节上运行的文本分类架构，使用频域处理，仅需733K参数。通过三种创新组件（RecurrentOscillatorBanks、FFT-Rotate Wavetable Encoder、PhaseHarmonics）实现O(L)时间/内存复杂度，在多个基准测试中超越参数量16倍的tokenized模型。
AI.motivation: 解决传统Transformer的高内存消耗问题（O(L²)复杂度），以及tokenization带来的信息损失和巨大嵌入表（65K参数）。现有基于字节的模型仍依赖注意力机制，效率较低。
AI.method: 提出三种创新组件：(1) RecurrentOscillatorBanks - 带时间记忆的阻尼正弦卷积，实现O(L)序列处理；(2) FFT-Rotate Wavetable Encoder - 用单可学习向量（256 floats）替代传统嵌入表；(3) PhaseHarmonics - 仅6个可学习参数的 sinusoidal 非线性。
AI.result: Kathleen-Clean在IMDB达到88.6%、AG News达92.3%、SST-2达83.3%；超越16倍参数的tokenized模型（IMDB +1.6%，AG News +2.1%）。消融实验表明PhaseHarmonics是最关键组件（+2.6%准确率，仅占参数量的<0.001%），而移除560K参数的生物启发框架仅损失-0.2%。
AI.conclusion: 频域处理方法系统性优于复杂认知架构，无需tokenizer和attention机制即可实现高效字节级处理，为长序列任务提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Learning is Forgetting: LLM Training As Lossy Compression
comment: 12 page core paper, 16 page Appendix - A shorter version with fewer visuals appears at ICLR 2026
summary: Despite the increasing prevalence of large language models (LLMs), we still have a limited understanding of how their representational spaces are structured. This limits our ability to interpret how and what they learn or relate them to learning in humans. We argue LLMs are best seen as an instance of lossy compression, where over training they learn by retaining only information in their training data relevant to their objective(s). We show pre-training results in models that are optimally compressed for next-sequence prediction, approaching the Information Bottleneck bound on compression. Across an array of open weights models, each compresses differently, likely due to differences in the data and training recipes used. However even across different families of LLMs the optimality of a model's compression, and the information present in it, can predict downstream performance on across a wide array of benchmarks, letting us directly link representational structure to actionable insights about model performance. In the general case the work presented here offers a unified Information-Theoretic framing for how these models learn that is deployable at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLM）的预训练理解为"有损压缩"过程，并用率失真理论/信息瓶颈（IB）框架加以刻画：预训练遵循"先扩张（提升与目标的互信息）、后压缩（丢弃与目标无关的输入信息）"的两阶段轨迹，逼近 IB 最优压缩边界；作者借助新近提出的软熵估计器（Conklin 2025）首次在 LLM 规模上实现了可扩展的互信息估计，并通过 n-gram 回退（token/bigram/trigram/quadgram）刻画表征所保留的信息结构，发现 47–75 个开源权重模型（6 个家族）最终都收敛到 IB 边界附近，且"压缩最优性"与"偏好信息量"能显著预测下游基准表现（r=0.52 与 r=0.76，p<0.001）。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM已被广泛使用，我们对其内部表征空间如何组织、如何"学习"以及哪些信息被保留/遗忘仍缺乏统一理解。已有可解释性工作多依赖行为实验、探针或因果干预，难以在超大模型上系统刻画整体表征结构；而学习即压缩（learning as compression）这一有信息论传统的理论脉络（Chater、Feldman、Bayesian Occam剃刀）尚未被操作化到当代LLM的预训练上。研究动机包含三个具体问题：(1) LLM 是否对表征进行最优压缩？(2) 压缩后究竟保留了哪些信息？(3) 什么样的表征结构驱动了下游性能？作者希望提供一个既有理论根基、又能以可扩展方式部署到任意规模模型的统一框架，从而把学习理论与实践解释性之间的断层缝合起来。
AI.method:
【理论框架】以编码器θ（Z=θ(X)）与解码器φ（Ŷ=φ(Z)）刻画LLM，用率失真理论定义"速率"为 I(X;Z)（complexity，表征保留的输入信息量）与"失真"为 I(Y;Z)（expressivity，表征关于目标的独特信息量），构成信息平面；最优压缩对应 IB 边界，即仅保留对预测 Y 相关的输入信息，边界可用 I(X;Z)=I(Z;Y) 这一线性下界刻画（数据处理不等式推出，比真实 IB 前沿更松但已足够）。作者还定义可比较的标量 Optimality = I(Y;Z)/I(X;Z) 作为"到边界的距离"。

【熵估计】由于分箱式离散化（Shwartz-Ziv & Tishby；Voita et al.）在 LLM 规模上内存/计算不可行，本文首次将 Conklin (2025) 的软熵估计器用于 RDT 分析：将各层 token 表征归一化到单位超球面，随机采样 n=100 个参考点 w_i，对余弦相似度做 softmax 得到软分配概率向量，跨 batch/序列平均后取 Shannon 熵，并以 log n 归一化得到"效率" ℋ(Z)。互信息由 I(X;Z)=ℋ(Z)−Σ_x P(x)ℋ(Z|X=x) 给出，条件分布通过对全局分布取子集获得。温度 ε 通过 von Mises–Fisher 核与均匀分布的 KL 散度解析上界校准（ε*≈1/√(2d log m)），以保证不同隐藏维度模型的可比性。

【输入/输出分布近似】因全上下文条件分布不可解，采用 Katz 式 n-gram 回退（token/bigram/trigram/quadgram）：X 为前置上下文，Y 为后置上下文（教师强制下当前嵌入接收后续 token 的梯度信息）；利用互信息链式法则分解各层级上下文贡献的比例 φ(x,n)，并定义残差信息。

【数据与模型】n-gram 估计使用 C4 的 10,000 条样本，偏好估计使用 Tulu 的 10,000 条样本，最大上下文长度 512；预训练动态基于 OLMo2 的 1B/7B/32B 中间检查点（附录另含 Smol LM2、Pythia）；跨模型比较使用 6 个家族共 47（附录图示 75）个开源权重模型；行为评估用 MMLU Pro、BBH、Math LVL5、IFEval、GPQA、MuSR 六项基准（Open LLM Leaderboard 评测与聚合），统计用 Spearman 相关与控制参数量协变量的偏相关。

【边界计算】用 Blahut–Arimoto 迭代求 IB 最优编码器，仅在词表 ≤5 万时可收敛（归一化 I(X;Y)≈0.7）；而所有开源模型的 token complexity 最高仅 0.15，远未饱和，故可用线性边界近似。
AI.result:
1) 两阶段轨迹：OLMo2 7B 在信息平面上先沿拟合阶段扩张 I(Y;Z)，随后压缩 I(X;Z) 并趋近 IB 边界，转折点与 C4 上的下一词预测损失开始饱和高度吻合，与 Shwartz-Ziv & Tishby (2017) 在 MNIST 上的结论一致；在 C4、Tulu、MMLU 三种数据分布、50/100 个参考点、均值与期望两种互信息定义下该模式均稳健（附录 G）。

2) 上下文与规模效应：所有回退层级都呈现同样的扩张—压缩模式，但上下文越长越贴近边界；在 trigram/quadgram 下复杂度与表达力同步下降（因语言建模中源/目标分布近乎相同，难以只压其一），作者由此假设高阶上下文编码是预训练目标的内在压力所致。信息分解显示模型绝大部分信息编码局部上下文（token→quadgram），可解释为"被平滑到可训练程度的上下文窗口宽度 n-gram 模型"。规模上 1B OLMo2（以及 Smol LM2 1.7B/400M/100M）虽完成扩张阶段，却长期振荡、无法实现有意义的压缩；7B 与 32B 则持续逼近边界，符合"数据复杂度与模型容量需匹配"的规模定律直觉。Pythia 因仅见约 7.5% 的 token 数量，其 1.4B 压缩出现更晚、6.9B 训练末期仍在扩张（似欠训练）。

3) 跨家族收敛：6 个家族、75 个开源权重模型在训练结束时均沿 IB 边界聚集，且趋近边界上的相似位置，说明"以压缩为学习"并非单一模型的训练轨迹特例，而是深度学习模型这一类别的普遍性质；不同家族因数据与训练配方不同，其压缩方式（保留的信息）各异。

4) 结构—性能关联（47 模型）：token 层级下 complexity 与表现显著负相关（r=−0.38, p=0.006），expressivity 单独不显著（r=0.08, p=0.575），而压缩最优性显著正相关（r=0.52, p<0.001）；占比上更少的 token 信息、更多的 bigram/trigram/quadgram 上下文信息均与更好表现相关。偏好信息量是更强的预测因子（r=0.76, p=0.001）。

5) 任务级分化：C4 上的最优压缩能预测数学、推理与事实知识类基准，但不能预测指令遵循（IFEval，r=0.07, p=0.631）；而偏好信息能预测 IFEval（r=0.39, p=0.004），并对其他基准也有预测力（可能部分反映 Tulu 偏好数据本身更偏好相关/正确回答的构造）。

6) 后训练作用：Llama 系列后训练检查点偏好信息一致更高；Gemma 3 亦如此，但更早版本不一致。表明预训练负责建立广义的压缩与语义信息，后训练则"编辑"其中所含的信息，而对复杂度影响很小。

7) 成本与可用性：估计仅需一次前向（余弦+softmax），10,000 条样本在 2/4/8 张 H100 上约 10/40/70 分钟，全文约 3,600 H100 小时；代码开源（soft_h）。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了一个可扩展部署的统一信息论解释框架：LLM 最好被理解为有损压缩器，训练即"学习即遗忘"——只保留对目标（下一序列预测）相关的信息。核心结论是：(a) 预训练严格遵循 IB 理论预测的扩张—压缩两阶段，且转折与损失饱和同步；(b) 模型规模是实现有意义压缩的必要条件（<7B 参数难以压缩）；(c) 跨家族的公开权重模型普遍收敛于 IB 边界，说明这是深度学习模型的类性质；(d) 表征结构具有可行动性：压缩最优性与偏好信息量能显著预测下游表现，把"最简表征"与"最强泛化"联系起来，并区分出由最优压缩带来的通用知识/推理能力与由偏好信息带来的指令遵循能力。方法论上，论文首次将软熵估计器应用于率失真分析，使 LLM 规模的互信息估计在内存、计算与在线性上可行。作者提出该框架可用于训练实践：当与边界的距离不再下降时作为预训练停止准则，或作为检查点/模型选择准则（依据最优性或偏好信息占比），因为单次前向的估计远比整套基准评测廉价。作者也坦承局限：熵是针对有限样本的估计而非真实潜分布熵；软熵仅捕捉表征的角向信息；quadgram 估计稀疏噪声大（部分估计甚至越过边界）；相关关系非因果；数值计算真实 IB 边界在词表超 5 万时不收敛，故以线性下界近似；小模型压缩失败部分可由数据复杂度与检查点时机解释。

title: Hidden Biases in Conditioning Autoregressive Models
summary: Large language and music models are increasingly used for constrained generation: rhyming lines, fixed meter, inpainting or infilling, positional endings, and other global form requirements. These systems often perform strikingly well, but the induced procedures are usually not exact conditioning of the underlying autoregressive model. This creates a hidden inferential bias, distinct from the better-known notion of bias inherited from the training set: samples are distorted relative to the true constrained distribution, with no generic guarantee of complete coverage of the admissible solution space or of correct conditional probabilities over valid completions. We formalize several exact inference tasks for autoregressive models and prove corresponding hardness results. For succinctly represented autoregressive models whose next-token probabilities are computable in polynomial time, exact sentence-level maximum a posteriori (MAP) decoding is NP-hard. This hardness persists under unary and metrical constraints. On the sampling side, exact conditioned normalization is \#P-hard even for regular constraints such as fixed-length terminal events. Unlike finite-state Markov models, general autoregressive models do not admit a bounded-state dynamic program for these tasks. These results formalize a standard claim in the neural decoding literature: local autoregressive sampling is easy, whereas exact decoding and exact conditioning under global form constraints are computationally intractable in general.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了在自回归模型中进行精确的约束推理是计算上不可行的：精确的MAP解码和精确的条件归一化都是难解的（NP-hard和#P-hard），即使在简单的约束条件下也是如此。这挑战了神经解码文献中关于局部自回归采样容易、但全局约束下精确解码和条件化在一般情况下难以处理的常见说法。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型和音乐模型在进行约束生成（如押韵、固定韵律、修复填充等）时表现良好，但这些方法并非对底层自回归模型的精确条件化。这导致了一个隐藏的推理偏差：样本相对于真实约束分布存在扭曲，无法保证完整覆盖可行解空间，也无法保证对有效补全的正确条件概率。
AI.method: 形式化了几种自回归模型的精确推理任务，包括句级最大后验（MAP）解码和条件归一化，并通过复杂性理论归约证明了这些问题的计算难度。
AI.result: 对于在多项式时间内可计算下一token概率的简洁表示自回归模型，精确的句级MAP解码是NP-hard的，即使在一元约束和韵律约束下也成立。精确的条件归一化对于正则约束（如固定长度终止事件）也是#P-hard的。与有限状态马尔可夫模型不同，一般自回归模型不支持这些任务的有界状态动态规划。
AI.conclusion: 局部自回归采样容易，但全局约束下的精确解码和精确条件化在一般情况下是计算难解的。这形式化了神经解码文献中的一个标准观点。

title: A Decomposition Perspective to Long-context Reasoning for LLMs
summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex real-world applications, yet remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid evolution in long-context reasoning, current research often overlooks the internal complexity of the long-context reasoning task itself. In this paper, we move beyond this holistic view and decompose long-context reasoning into a set of fundamental atomic skills, and we then automatically synthesize a suite of pseudo datasets, each explicitly targeting a specific atomic skill. Our empirical analysis confirms that proficiency in these atomic skills is strongly correlated with general long-text reasoning performance. Building on this insight, we employ reinforcement learning on these pseudo datasets to sharpen the model's atomic skills, in the hope of boosting its general long-context reasoning ability. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach: it outperforms a strong baseline by an average margin of 7.7\% (improving from 46.3\% to 54.0\%) across Loogle, Loong, LongBench-v2, BrowscompLong, Ruler-qa2, and MRCR.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「分解视角」看待长上下文推理：将长文本推理拆解为五项原子技能（基础检索、抗干扰、全局整合、关系推理、动态状态跟踪），并用基于锚点（Anchor-based Reasoning, AbR）三阶段自动化管线合成约4k条可验证的伪数据；相关性实验证实原子技能得分与真实长上下文基准高度相关（Spearman ρ最高0.99），再对这些数据做GRPO强化学习，可将长上下文推理平均分从46.3%提升到54.0%（+7.7%），并在Loogle/Loong/LongBench-v2/BrowsCompLong/RULER-qa2/MRCR上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理（context window 已达百万级）是复杂现实应用的核心能力，但当前研究多把长上下文推理当作一个「整体/单体」任务来对待：直接构造高质量长上下文训练数据面临验证不足导致的虚假信息风险、人工/自动采集数据中的潜在知识冲突等难以解决的数据质量与规模化瓶颈。作者主张从认知科学角度，长上下文推理实为一个由若干基础「原子技能」构成的层级化谱系；若能自动合成针对各原子技能的可验证数据，则可绕开单体数据构造的困境，并有望以小规模数据高效提升模型通用长文本推理能力（此前实验也表明多数模型的提升瓶颈不在检索本身，而在抗干扰与全局整合）。
AI.method: 1）提出原子技能分类体系（按认知复杂度递增）：Foundational Retrieval（NIAH，定位「针」并克服 lost-in-the-middle）、Anti-Interference（相似干扰区分 + 冲突信息消解）、Global Integration（跨多文档线索碎片聚合）、Relational Reasoning（集合交并等结构化位置约束逻辑，如「唯一锚点计数+按文档密度选文档+取最后一个唯一锚点」）与 Dynamic State Tracking（条件逻辑 + 多步计算，需在「工作记忆」中保持中间状态）。2）设计 Anchor-based Reasoning (AbR) 自动化数据合成管线：三阶段——Stage 1 生成 doc_mapping（锚点到文档的映射蓝图，定义 ground truth）；Stage 2 基于蓝图用规则模板或 LLM 生成元问题，其答案被表示为可执行表达式（如 solve(Q(anc, in_doc(docs(anc5)∩docs(anc3))))、求和式等）；Stage 3 组装多文档上下文——为每个 doc_id 选取无关背景噪声文本，按蓝图将「锚点-问题」对随机插入位置，构造出信息定位→嵌入问题求解→逻辑整合的流程；通过调节上下文长度、锚点密度、噪声相似度、推理深度可精确控制难度以支持课程学习。3）验证阶段：对11个7B–32B开源模型在≤128K上下文下，用 Spearman ρ 检验各原子技能探针与 Loogle/LongBench-v2/Loong 等真实基准均分的相关性，并以 OOlong-synth、GSM-infinite 作为对照组；并对比绝对分数以识别「高相关-低表现」错配、检索天花板与鲁棒性瓶颈。4）训练阶段：在约4k条合成数据上用 GRPO（组内均值作基线、裁剪目标 + KL 惩罚）+ Dynamic Sampling 剪除奖励同质化轨迹，奖励由 gpt-oss-120B 作为 LLM-as-a-Judge 给二元正确性奖励；Instruct 模型额外加 CoT 系统提示与格式合规奖励，已有 CoT 的模型走标准流程；数据由 DeepSeek V3.1 采样并按 pass rate 0.3–0.6 过滤难度，混合比 Anti-interfere:Multi-hop:Multi-source:Logic:Calc-reason:NIAH = 5:3:2:2:2:1；backbone 为 Qwen2.5-14B/32B-Instruct 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-32B（均冷启动、无先前微调策略），输入/输出最大长度 24k/8k，64 张 H20 训练。5）分析：消融各原子数据模块、原子探针非正交性/层级依赖热力图、原子能力增益对比，以及 LongBench-v2 上按 8k–128k 长度分桶的鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: 相关性验证：原子探针与真实基准均分高度相关（NIAH ρ=0.95、Anti-interfere ρ=0.94、Calc-reason ρ=0.94、Multi-source ρ=0.91；Loong 上 Multi-source ρ=0.99，全部 p<0.001），而通用基线 OOlong-synth 仅 ρ=0.17、GSM-infinite ρ=0.70，显著弱于 Calc-reason；绝对分数显示「高相关-低表现」错配（如 Qwen2.5-32B-instruct 在 NIAH 37.00%、Anti-interfere 22.13%、Multi-source 23.88%、Logic 13.00%）与检索天花板、鲁棒性瓶颈。主结果：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-32B+Ours 平均 54.03%，较基座 46.30% 绝对提升 7.7%（Loogle +13.3、Ruler-qa2 +9.8），优于三个直接基线 LongReason(45.84%)、QwenDocQA(51.31%)、LoongRL(50.71%)，超过 Kimi-K2-Thinking(53.11%)、DeepSeek-V3.1(50.84%)、Qwen3-235B(49.66%)、QwenLong-L1-32B(47.18%)；与 1k LoongRL 数据叠加达 54.46%，显示互补协同（Gemini-3-Pro 以 72.34% 仍领先）。跨骨干：Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 35.59%→45.83%（+10.24，其中 Ruler-qa2 40.28→63.21、BrowsCompLong 47.30→69.72），Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 41.54%→45.50%。消融：移除 Multi-source 会使 Loong/LongBench-v2 低于基座（技能失衡）；移除 Logic 主要拉低 BrowsCompLong/Ruler-qa2；移除 Calc_reason 影响全局。原子探针：Logic 由约18%→68.8%，Calc_reason 约翻倍至80.7%，相对 LoongRL 在 Anti-interfere(+26.7) 与 Logic(+41.8) 上优势显著。长度鲁棒性：32k–64k 区间从 48.48% 提升至 59.09%，64k–128k 仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文推理应被视为层级化的原子能力谱系而非单体技能：五类原子技能（基础检索、抗干扰、全局整合、关系推理、动态状态跟踪）可作为真实长上下文能力的可靠代理（ρ最高0.99），且其相互非正交、存在层级依赖（逻辑结构支撑动态状态计算，全局整合起基础稳定器作用）。借助基于锚点的自动可验证数据管线，仅用约4k条合成数据进行 GRPO 强化学习，即可实现数据高效的长上下文能力提升（+7.7%平均增益），并能与已有 LoongRL 等数据构造管线叠加使用。局限与启示：模型当前的主要短板是抗干扰与全局整合而非检索本身；提升 NIAH 存在收益递减；未来可进一步自动化难度课程与跨模型扩展。

title: Implicit Regularization and Generalization in Overparameterized Neural Networks
summary:
Classical statistical learning theory predicts that overparameterized models should exhibit severe overfitting, yet modern deep neural networks with far more parameters than training samples consistently generalize well. This contradiction has become a central theoretical question in machine learning.
  This study investigates the role of optimization dynamics and implicit regularization in enabling generalization in overparameterized neural networks through controlled experiments. We examine stochastic gradient descent (SGD) across batch sizes, the geometry of flat versus sharp minima via Hessian eigenvalue estimation and weight perturbation analysis, the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regime through wide-network experiments, double descent across model scales, and the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis through iterative magnitude pruning. All experiments use PyTorch on CIFAR-10 and MNIST with multiple random seeds.
  Our findings demonstrate that generalization is strongly influenced by the interaction between network architecture, optimization algorithms, and loss landscape geometry. Smaller batch sizes consistently produced lower test error and flatter minima, with an 11.8x difference in top Hessian eigenvalue between small-batch and large-batch solutions corresponding to 1.61 percentage points higher test accuracy. Sparse subnetworks retaining only 10% of parameters achieved within 1.15 percentage points of full model performance when retrained from their original initialization. These results highlight the need for revised learning-theoretic frameworks capable of explaining generalization in high-dimensional model regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上的受控 PyTorch 实验，系统检验了过参数化神经网络泛化的五种解释机制：SGD 的隐式正则化、损失面平坦/尖锐极小值几何、NTK 极限、double descent 与彩票彩票假说（Lottery Ticket）。核心量化结果：小批量（bs=32）比大批量（bs=2048）测试精度高 2.25 个百分点；小批量与大批量模型的最大 Hessian 特征值相差 11.8 倍（0.19 vs 2.24），对应 1.61 个百分点的精度差；保留 10% 参数的子网从原初始化重训仅损失 1.15 个百分点（随机重初始化则差 2.80 个百分点）；宽度 32→4096 时相对参数位移下降 11.3 倍但仍为 0.08，说明未真正进入 NTK 极限。结论是：参数数量本身不足以刻画有效容量，泛化取决于架构、优化动力学、损失面几何与数据统计性质的相互作用；但缺乏统一形式化理论，且因果性仅为相关性证据。
AI.motivation: 经典统计学习理论（VC 维、均匀收敛界）预测参数量远超样本量时应严重过拟合，但现代深度网络在过参数化区间仍泛化良好，这一矛盾构成本文的核心理论问题。作者指出已有工作多孤立考察单一机制（SGD 隐式正则化、损失面几何、NTK、double descent、Lottery Ticket），缺乏在同一实验框架下的统一受控比较与机制间交互分析，因此本研究试图通过统一实验设计澄清这些机制如何共同解释泛化。
AI.method: 采用计算实验研究设计，在 PyTorch 2.6.0 + CUDA 12.4、RTX 3070 Ti 上对 MNIST（双下降用 10,000 子集；NTK 用 5,000 子集）与 CIFAR-10 进行实验，每组 5 个随机种子，结果为均值±标准差，1,000 次 bootstrap 95% CI，Welch t 检验（α=0.05）。①隐式正则化：CNN(base_channels=32，~814k 参数)，SGD 批量 32–2048 且学习率线性缩放（bs=128 时 lr=0.01），对比 Adam 与全批量 GD（用 5,000 样本子集）。②损失面几何：高斯权重扰动 θ'=θ+ε（σ=5e-4~5e-2，7 档 × 5 次采样）测训练损失增幅；Hessian 最大特征值用自动微分 Hessian-向量积 + 幂迭代 30 次（1,000 样本子集）。③双下降：4 层 ReLU MLP 宽度 8–4096（6.5k–36.8M 参数）与 6 层 CNN（base channels 4–96，73k–4.15M 参数）。④NTK 近似：MLP 宽度 32–4096，计算相对参数位移 Δθ_rel=‖θ_T−θ_0‖₂/‖θ_0‖₂。⑤Lottery Ticket：迭代幅值剪枝（保留 5%–100%），保留权重回退至原始初始化并加掩码重训 60 epoch；设置随机重初始化对照组。⑥无 weight decay/dropout 以隔离隐式正则化。
AI.result: (1) 隐式正则化：所有 SGD 配置训练精度均 100%，测试精度随批量减小单调上升（85.52% @32 → 83.27% @2048），泛化差 14.48%→16.73%；Adam(bs=128) 达 85.47%，与大批量 SGD 相当；全批量 GD 仅 32.71%（训练精度 36.7%）。(2) 损失面：小批量最大 Hessian 特征值 0.19，大批量 2.24（11.8×），精度 85.78% vs 84.17%（1.61 pp）；σ=0.005 时损失增幅 158% vs 1932%（12.2×），各 σ 档均支持小批量更平坦。(3) 双下降：MNIST 在宽度 32（27.5k 参数、2.8×n）达 100% 训练精度后测试精度仍由 95.4% 升至 96.9%（93× 过参数化）；CIFAR-10 CNN 在 ch=8（152k 参数）附近测试精度 27.6±17.5%（高方差峰），随容量增至 4.15M 参数升至 72.0%。(4) NTK：Δθ_rel 由 0.9356（宽 32）单调降至 0.0831（宽 4096），11.3× 降幅，翻倍宽度约降 30%，符合 O(1/√w)；测试精度 91.6%→93.9%；但最宽网络仍为 0.08，提示特征学习仍存在。(5) Lottery Ticket：保留 30% 参数 84.74%，保留 10% 参数 83.72%（较全模型 84.87% 仅差 1.15 pp）；保留 70% 时 85.27% 略优于全模型；随机重初始化对照降至 80.92%，差距 2.80 pp，验证原始初始化的关键性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要结论是：没有任何单一理论框架能解释过参数化网络的泛化，泛化由多种机制共同涌现——SGD 噪声产生的优化偏置引导模型趋向低有效复杂度解并倾向平坦极小值；更大模型的 double descent 第二次下降可能部分源于高维参数空间中更丰富的平坦盆地可获得性；宽网络的核化行为提供训练稳定性（但尚未完全达到 NTK 极限）；过参数化使稀疏"中奖彩票"子网更易被发现。作者亦给出因果性的审慎说明：观测性实验无法区分"小批量噪声→平坦极小值→更好泛化"与"归纳偏置与数据结构对齐→同时导致平坦与泛化"两条路径，缺少随模型尺度变化的盆地体积直接测量。局限包括数据集与架构范围窄（MNIST/CIFAR-10、MLP+带 BN 的 CNN，未涵盖 Transformer）、Hessian 估计基于子集与幂迭代仅为局部近似、BN 本身构成额外隐式正则化干扰、参数规模最高约 37M 而远小于生产规模，且缺少统一的形式化数学框架，未来方向包括扩展到 Transformer/大规模模型、建立连接隐式正则化与损失面几何及 double descent 的统一理论、探究平坦极小值与对抗鲁棒性的关联、以及分析不同初始化下"中奖彩票"的结构共性。

title: Auto-Configured Networks for Multi-Scale Multi-Output Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Industrial forecasting often involves multi-source asynchronous signals and multi-output targets, while deployment requires explicit trade-offs between prediction error and model complexity. Current practices typically fix alignment strategies or network designs, making it difficult to systematically co-design preprocessing, architecture, and hyperparameters in budget-limited training-based evaluations. To address this issue, we propose an auto-configuration framework that outputs a deployable Pareto set of forecasting models balancing error and complexity. At the model level, a Multi-Scale Bi-Branch Convolutional Neural Network (MS--BCNN) is developed, where short- and long-kernel branches capture local fluctuations and long-term trends, respectively, for multi-output regression. At the search level, we unify alignment operators, architectural choices, and training hyperparameters into a hierarchical-conditional mixed configuration space, and apply Player-based Hybrid Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (PHMOEA) to approximate the error--complexity Pareto frontier within a limited computational budget. Experiments on hierarchical synthetic benchmarks and a real-world sintering dataset demonstrate that our framework outperforms competitive baselines under the same budget and offers flexible deployment choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向工业多源异步、多输出时序预测的自动配置框架：在模型层设计多尺度双分支卷积网络 MS-BCNN（短核/长核并行分支 + 可配置重采样对齐与分支融合），在搜索层把对齐算子、结构与训练超参统一进分层条件混合空间，用玩家式混合多目标进化算法 PHMOEA 在有限预算内逼近"误差–参数量"帕累托前沿，最终输出可部署的帕累托模型集。在合成基准（H-DTLZ2/7）与真实烧结数据集上，PHMOEA 的 IGD=0.0163、HV=0.986，且仅用 1113.6 次评估（基线均为 1500）；MS-BCNN 在乱序与时序两种划分下均取得最优 NMSE/NMAE（0.268/0.348；4.446/1.682），优于 OB-ISSID、Ventingformer、Transformer、LSTM、GRU-PLS。
AI.motivation: 工业过程（如烧结）预测面临三重困难：(1) 多源传感器异步采样，必须先做时间对齐/重采样，而不同对齐策略（插值、抽取-重复、池化、模糊池化、FIR 低通）在高频波动保留、噪声抑制与缺失处理上差异显著，其效果强依赖采样稀疏度、噪声水平与跨尺度耦合，难以靠经验手选；(2) 多尺度结构与训练超参同预处理相互耦合，候选配置爆炸，而每个候选都需要一次完整训练-验证，评估预算极其受限；(3) 部署时"预测误差 vs 模型复杂度/推理成本"天然冲突，不同部署约束需要不同工作点，因此需要一组帕累托模型而非单一最优点。现有 AutoML 范式多基于标准化搜索空间与通用任务，难以直接容纳重采样/聚合等预处理算子；而主流时序预测工作通常固定预处理与架构，只报告单一工作点。因此本文将问题形式化为预算受限、含混合变量与可行性约束的多目标黑箱优化，并要求输出面向部署的帕累托模型集。
AI.method:
**模型层 MS-BCNN**：各源序列先由可配置对齐算子重采样到统一长度 L_p（linear / decimate_repeat / hybrid / pool / conv_blurpool / fir_lowpass），与正余弦周期时间嵌入拼接后经逐时刻线性投影到 C_0 通道；主干为固定 3 层双分支 1D 卷积，短核分支捕捉局部快波动、长核分支捕捉慢趋势，每层顺序为 Conv1D→Norm→Act→Dropout（stride 1、长度保持），最后用可配置融合算子（concat / add / weighting / gating / attention / cross_mapping）合并两分支，展平后接单层线性预测头输出 K 维多目标结果。

**搜索层分层条件混合空间**：24 个决策变量（x1–x24）按层级组织，条件变量仅当父级离散选择被激活时才生效，用激活指示 a_j^(ℓ)(x) 掩蔽以保证解码可执行；统一离散索引编码（连续变量按线性或对数分箱为 K_d 个 bin，取箱中点代表值）；分层修复 + 拉马克式回写（连续变量裁剪到安全区间，非激活变量语义冻结并保留最近有效值）；对"修复+解码"后的可执行配置做规范化序列化哈希去重，重复候选在训练前拒绝，失败时按 n_trial 重试、否则跳过该后代槽位；连续变量自适应细化——统计当代非支配解在各区间的质量占比，超过阈值 δ_h 且连续 H 代则细分该区间，实现由粗到细搜索。

**PHMOEA**：以维度级候选为"玩家"，维护热度档案 ℋ 与计数档案 𝒞；由非支配秩、归一化拥挤度（NSGA-II 拥挤距离）与目标引导项构成阶段相关评分 R_i（早期偏秩-多样性、中期混合、后期偏目标+拥挤），归一化为权重更新档案；每代按阶段比例 (ρ_par, ρ_hot, ρ_nh) 生成三类后代：父代算子（SBX 交叉 + 多项式变异）、Hot 池（均匀采样 top-q% 高热维度）、NonHot 池（冷集带 cold-bonus 因子加权采样），组装型后代再做跨池变异；随后统一环境选择（NSGA-II 式）在 P_t∪Q_t 上保留 N 个个体，并设基于停滞信号的早停（窗口 W=8）。复杂度为 O(FEs·C)，最坏 O(T_max·N·C)，修复/去重/早停实际降低有效评估数。
AI.result:
**搜索质量**：合成基准 H-DTLZ2/H-DTLZ7 上 PHMOEA 的 IGD 曲线下降更快、更早稳定于低 IGD 水平（收敛速度优于基线），但最终代 IGD/HV 并非全面最优（H-DTLZ2 上 MOEA/D、NSGA-III、SMS-EMOA 的 IGD 略优）。真实烧结任务上 PHMOEA 取得最优或并列最优：IGD 0.0163±0.0026、HV 0.986±0.005，均显著优于 MOEA/D（IGD 0.1400、HV 0.781）、NSGA-II（IGD 0.0308）、NSGA-III（IGD 0.0282），与 SMS-EMOA（IGD 0.0175）无显著差异；FEs 仅 1113.6±1.9，低于所有基线的 1500。

**预测性能**：乱序（近 i.i.d.）划分下 MS-BCNN 整体最优，NMSE 0.268±0.217、NMAE 0.348±0.138、MAPE 1.19%（Ventingformer 0.279/0.366/1.25，OB-ISSID 0.304/0.381/1.31，LSTM 0.380/0.421，Transformer 0.456/0.483，GRU-PLS 0.462/0.512）。时序划分下所有模型误差显著放大，但 MS-BCNN 仍以 NMSE 4.446±2.193、NMAE 1.682±0.490 领先（OB-ISSID 119.7/8.003、LSTM 114.8/6.334、GRU-PLS 10.7/2.795、Transformer 7.58/2.180、Ventingformer 4.789/1.698），仅 MAPE 略逊于 Ventingformer（3.02% vs 2.89%）；误差散点更集中于零误差区。

**消融**：PHMOEA 去掉精英保留退化最明显（H-DTLZ2 IGD 0.0052→0.0089，H-DTLZ7 0.0033→0.0103），去重仅轻微影响精度但提升效率；MS-BCNN 去掉时间嵌入使整体 NMSE 升至 5.660，短核单支（4.910）与长核单支（4.957）均劣于双分支（4.446）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把"预处理对齐算子 + 多尺度双分支结构 + 训练超参"统一到同一分层条件混合空间，用 PHMOEA 在有限评估预算内以更少评估次数逼近误差–复杂度帕累托前沿，输出的帕累托模型集为不同部署约束（精度优先/成本优先）提供可选工作点；实验表明其在同预算下优于 MOEA/D、NSGA-II/III、SMS-EMOA，MS-BCNN 在烧结多目标质量预测上整体最优且对时序漂移更稳健。局限与未来工作：复杂度目标仅以可训练参数量近似（未直接度量真实推理时延/能耗）；合成基准最终代指标并非全面最优；真实烧结过程存在明显工况切换与分布漂移，未来需发展面向非平稳性的动态学习与在线漂移响应维护机制，并将离线帕累托集作为后续动态学习的候选初始化与结构先验，以降低适配成本、提升长期运行可靠性与可扩展性。

title: DialBGM: A Benchmark for Background Music Recommendation from Everyday Multi-Turn Dialogues
summary: Selecting an appropriate background music (BGM) that supports natural human conversation is a common production step in media and interactive systems. In this paper, we introduce dialogue-conditioned BGM recommendation, where a model should select non-intrusive, fitting music for a multi-turn conversation that often contains no music descriptors. To study this novel problem, we present DialBGM, a benchmark of 1,200 open-domain daily dialogues, each paired with four candidate music clips and annotated with human preference rankings. Rankings are determined by background suitability criteria, including contextual relevance, non-intrusiveness, and consistency. We evaluate a wide range of open-source and proprietary models, including audio-language models and multimodal LLMs, and show that current models fall far short of human judgments; no model exceeds 35% Hit@1 when selecting the top-ranked clip. DialBGM provides a standardized benchmark for developing discourse-aware methods for BGM selection and for evaluating both retrieval-based and generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新任务「对话条件化背景音乐推荐」（dialogue-conditioned BGM recommendation），并发布 DialBGM 基准：1,200 段 DailyDialog 多轮对话，每条配 4 个 MusicCaps 候选片段并带 12 名专家人工偏好排序，共 4,800 个「对话-音乐」对。系统评测了 11 个开源/闭源模型（CLAP 系列、Audio/Music Flamingo、GPT-4o-audio、Gemini 2.5、Qwen2.5-Omni、Phi-4-Multimodal 等），结论是当前模型远不及人类判断——最优 Hit@1 仅约 0.35（去掉 CoT 的 Gemini 2.5 Pro 达 0.3712），MRR<0.60，nDCG@4 虽达 0.74–0.80 但 Kendall's τ_b 仅 −0.04~0.21，且模型间一致性 τ_b<0.4；文本-only 条件反而是最佳设定，说明瓶颈在情感/语用推理而非音频感知。
AI.motivation: 背景音乐在影视、游戏、VR、对话系统中广泛用于塑造氛围，但自动从文本对话中挑选合适 BGM 几乎无人研究。既有工作（CLAP、LAION-CLAP、MuseChat 等音频-文本对齐）默认查询文本中含显式音乐描述（风格、艺人、标签），而日常多轮对话通常完全没有音乐线索，且目标是「作为背景的适宜性」（契合、不抢话、不打断对话流）而非语义对应。此外，影视/预告片类 BGM 选择可依赖画面与视听信号，而本任务只能从对话中推断隐含的情绪轨迹、意图与语用（如讽刺、尴尬、紧张后缓和）。作者希望建立首个面向该任务的标准化评测基准，并检验现有音频-语言模型与多模态大模型是否具备这种「话语感知」的匹配能力。
AI.method: 任务形式化为条件排序：给定对话 d 与候选集 M={m1..m4}，输出 1–4 的排序排列 G，衡量相对偏好而非单一检索。指标采用 Hit@1、MRR、nDCG@4（相关性 3-2-1-0）、Kendall's τ_b，并给出「并列感知」变体（Hit@1 对 k 路并列给 1/k，MRR/nDCG/τ_b 用概率期望或并列校正分母），以处理 LLM 常输出的相同分数。数据构建为四阶段半自动流水线：Stage 1 基于 MusicCaps aspect_list 关键词（vocal/speech、static/hiss、pop/knock）规则过滤掉含人声、噪声与突出音效的片段，保留约 2,000 条纯器乐；Stage 2 用 GPT-4o 做「音乐导向」的对话压缩：单句（20–35 词）同时含话题、3–5 个情绪词、3–5 个关键词与 BGM 建议（风格/乐器/节奏/能量）；Stage 3 用 text-embedding-3-large 将 13,000 条对话描述与 2,000 条音乐描述嵌入同一空间做余弦相似度检索，采用「1+3 采样」：相似度 Top-1 + 从 Top-10% 中随机 3 首，以避免候选过于同质并提供声学对比（4 首选 4 因仅需 6 次成对比较，6/8 首需 15/28 次，标注疲劳与一致性会显著恶化）；Stage 4 由 12 名具备语音/音频研究背景的标注者通过 Gradio 界面实际听音频后排序，标准为相关性（mood/能量对齐）、非侵入性（人声、突出音效、干扰元素扣分）、一致性（氛围稳定不突变），用 Kendall 和谐系数 W 做质控，剔除 W<0.25 或处于一致度后 10% 的样本（约 15%），以 Borda 计数（3/2/1/0）聚合共识标签，并用 Rank-1 票数→Rank-2 票数→平均秩→候选 ID 逐级破平。实验覆盖多模态 LLM、音频语言模型与检索式模型三类共 11 个系统，比较「完整对话 vs GPT-4o 单句摘要」「直接音频 vs 音乐描述」等输入配置，并做文本-only 消融、CoT/少样本/四轨联合重排等提示工程消融，以及跨模型两两 τ_b 一致性矩阵分析。
AI.result: 1) 所有模型 Hit@1 均不超过约 35%（表 3 最佳 Gemini 2.5 Flash 0.3293 / Gemini 2.5 Pro 0.3233），MRR 0.49–0.60，nDCG@4 0.74–0.80 看似不低，但 τ_b 仅 −0.04~0.18，说明名次次序与人类偏好一致性很弱；运行间 Hit@1 标准差仅 ±0.002~±0.038，排名稳定。2) 完整对话与单句摘要差异甚微，表明瓶颈不在对话表示粒度。3) 文本-only 消融（表 4/5）反而取得最高分（Gemini 2.5 Pro 0.3491/0.3422，GPT-5-mini 0.3474/0.3321，τ_b≈0.20–0.21），说明当前限制并非音频感知问题，而是情感/语用推理缺陷：模型难以把对话叙事内容映射到音乐的「氛围」描述。4) 高级提示无效甚至有害：CoT 诱导模型编造音频属性，Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 CoT 结果（0.3712/0.2544）反而优于文中正文表格口径；少样本示例+显式准则无一致提升（Gemini 0.3443，GPT-4o-audio 0.2949）；四轨联合重排在 GPT-4o-audio 上边际改善但 Gemini 2.5 Pro 下降（0.3204）。5) 模型间偏好一致性低：多模态 LLM 簇内 τ_b≈0.28–0.37，Flamingo 系族内 ≈0.35 但与 LMM 簇 <0.2，CLAP 系列与 LMM 簇近乎零或负相关（<0.1），最相似模型对之间 τ_b 仍 <0.4，说明缺乏共享的「对话情境→音乐语义」偏好结构。6) 定性分析显示模型会过度拟合表层关键词（如对话中因学业受挫婉拒派对，模型却因「party」一词检索出「spirited」音乐），忽视语用与情绪叙事。7) 数据最终为 1,200 条对话（平均 7.85 轮、85.98 词）、1,020 条唯 clips（平均 10 秒）、4,800 对；话题以日常生活 68%、工作事业 19%、人际关系 9% 为主；情绪分布中性 41%、积极 36%、消极 14%、混合 9%；音乐以古典/管弦 15%、电子 11%、爵士蓝调 10%、摇滚金属 10% 为主；标注一致性 mean W=0.79、median W=0.90、92.16% 样本 W≥0.50。
AI.conclusion: DialBGM 是首个面向多轮对话与背景音乐匹配的人工排序基准，填补了音频-文本检索与对话式音乐推荐之间的空白。实验表明该任务本质上依赖从语用线索推断隐含情绪轨迹，现有模型在绝对精度与排序一致性上均大幅落后于人类共识；文本-only 设定即为最佳，说明能力不会从现有预训练中零样本涌现，提示工程亦不足以弥补。因此作者定位 DialBGM 为评测与微调资源（而非从零训练 LALM 的语料），未来方向是训练音频-语言模型专用适配器，或设计显式建模对话与音乐「情绪/氛围」对齐的新预训练目标。局限包括：数据规模偏小（1,200 条）、候选池受 MusicCaps 单一来源偏差影响、标注本质主观（共识排序无法覆盖全部合理解释），并需注意下游使用的版权与授权合规。

title: Guaranteeing Knowledge Integration with Joint Decoding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by providing access to external knowledge. However, current research primarily focuses on retrieval quality, often overlooking the critical ''integration bottleneck'': even when relevant documents are retrieved, LLMs frequently fail to utilize them effectively due to conflicts with their internal parametric knowledge. In this paper, we argue that implicitly resolving this conflict in a single generation pass is suboptimal. We introduce GuarantRAG, a framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from evidence integration. First, we generate an ''Inner-Answer'' based solely on parametric knowledge to capture the model's reasoning flow. Second, to guarantee faithful evidence extraction, we generate a ''Refer-Answer'' using a novel Contrastive DPO objective. This objective treats the parametric Inner-Answer as a negative constraint and the retrieved documents as positive ground truth, forcing the model to suppress internal hallucinations in favor of external evidence during this phase. Finally, rather than naive concatenation or using the DPO trained model directly, we propose a joint decoding mechanism that dynamically fuses the logical coherence of the Inner-Answer with the factual precision of the Refer-Answer at the token level. Experiments on five QA benchmarks demonstrate that GuarantRAG improves accuracy by up to 12.1% and reduces hallucinations by 16.3% compared to standard and dynamic RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: GuarantRAG 将 RAG 中"参数化知识 vs. 检索证据"的隐式冲突整合过程显式拆解为"生成+联合解码"两路：先用模型自身参数知识生成推理骨架 Inner-Answer，再用 Contrastive DPO（以检索文档为 chosen、Inner-Answer 为 rejected）训练证据模型生成忠于文档的 Refer-Answer，最后在隐状态层做 segment-level 联合解码融合。二者在 5 个 QA 基准上相比标准/动态 RAG 最高提升 12.1% 准确率、降低 16.3% 幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 研究聚焦检索质量与检索触发策略，却忽视"整合瓶颈"：即使检索到正确文档，LLM 常因内部参数化知识与外部证据冲突而无法有效利用，表现为两类失败模式——Parametric Override（忽略检索细节、回归内部先验）与 Disjointed Integration（生硬插入外部事实、破坏推理流）。作者在 500 条知识密集查询上的预研（GPT-4o + BM25，检索权重 λ 从 0.2 到 1.0）发现：67.3% 的 RAG 回复存在整合失败，且存在"事实准确性 ↑ 与连贯性 ↓"的此消彼长（λ=1.0 时准确率 81.5% 但连贯性仅 66.3%）；失败类型分布为信息遗漏 42.8%、矛盾 24.3%、事实混淆 19.1%、相关性错误 13.8%。因此论文主张：把知识冲突在单次生成中隐式化解是次优的，应显式解耦"推理连贯性（参数化）"与"事实忠实性（非参数化）"两个目标。
AI.method:
三阶段流水线：
(1) Knowledge Decision：基于基座 LLM 微调轻量二分类估计器（蒸馏至 Qwen3-1.7B），依据时间相关性（是否超出训练截止）与事实具体性（是否需长尾知识）决定是否检索；
(2) Dual-Path Generation：Path A 用基座模型 π_θ 仅凭参数知识生成 Inner-Answer，保留推理结构与语言流畅性作为"结构模板"；Path B 训练证据模型 π_φ 生成 Refer-Answer，采用 Contrastive DPO——以检索文档内容为 chosen、模型自身幻觉的 Inner-Answer 为 rejected，惩罚其在冲突时依赖参数记忆；并加入两项辅助约束：自适应长度正则 L_len=max(0,|y_ref|−|y_inner|)² 与事实相关性约束 L_fact=1−cos(E(q),E(y_ref))，总损失 L=L_DPO+λ1L_len+λ2L_fact（λ1/λ2 随训练由 0.4/0.6 调度到 0.6/0.4）；
(3) Joint Decoding：先用轻量辅助 LLM 将 Refer-Answer 分解为原子语义段 S_ref（平均 5.7 段、43.2 token/段），再在逐 token 解码时用句编码器计算当前生成句段与证据段的相似度 w_j=softmax(h(s_curr)ᵀh(s_j)/τ)，选 argmax 段 s*，在投影到词表前做隐状态软干预 h̃_t=h_gen+γ·h(s*)（γ=0.68），再经 Softmax(W_v h̃_t) 输出 token。
实现细节：AdamW、lr 2e-5、weight decay 0.01、3 epoch、约 50K 合成问答对、batch 32；对比融合编码器为 6 层 Transformer；知识源为 Wikipedia(2023.01)+Wikidata+ArXiv 摘要，Faiss 索引约 21M 文档。
AI.result: 在 NQ、TruthfulQA、WoW、HotpotQA、ELI5 五个基准、Qwen3-4B/7B/8B/14B(-T) 及 DeepSeek-V3/R1、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Claude-3.7-Sonnet 等 API 模型、BM25/SPLADE-v3/RetroMAE/HyDE 四种检索器上一致领先。Qwen3-14B-T：GuarantRAG 均分 76.7（vs P-RAG 73.8、SOLAR 71.9、Standard RAG 64.0），幻觉率 18.4%（P-RAG 25.6%），实体精度 89.3%，结构连贯 4.74；Qwen3-14B 均分 75.8、幻觉率仅 13.2%。相对 Standard RAG 最高提升 12.1% 准确率、降低 16.3% 幻觉，HotpotQA 上 EM 较 P-RAG 最高 +8.7。消融：去长度控制 −7.4、去相关性控制 −5.1、去 segment 级融合 −5.3、去 DPO −3.7；segment 级融合可独立迁移至 Vanilla RAG（EM +2.6），完整方法 EM +6.2。分解粒度上 segment 级注意力分布优于 token/句级。鲁棒性：注入 16.7%–50% 噪声文档仍保持 90.3% 原性能，优于 SelfRAG/RQ-RAG/SOLAR；在复杂推理与超长文档上增益最大；不同决策模块（分类器/关键词/置信度/相似度/随机）性能差异 <1%，说明增益源于联合解码而非决策精度。效率：延迟 4.23s、token 2,323、成本 1.3×（低于 SelfRAG 1.7×、SOLAR 2.0×、P-RAG 1.8×），质量增益 +16.3%。统计显著性 p<0.002。Inner-Answer 结构有效性经人工/Gemini 3.1 Pro 评估（语法连贯 96.8%/91.8%，结构有效 89.4%/93.2%），支撑"解耦安全"。
AI.conclusion: 知识整合（而非检索质量）是 RAG 在知识密集任务中的根本瓶颈，显式解耦参数化推理与非参数化证据、并以 segment 级隐状态联合解码进行细粒度融合，比既有隐式融合策略更有原则性，可同时获得高事实准确率与高结构连贯性，且对检索噪声更鲁棒、推理开销低于同类动态 RAG 方法。局限：双路生成与联合解码带来额外时延，实时场景受限；效果依赖训练数据覆盖，高专业术语或复杂关系型领域可能退化；DPO 需精细调 λ1/λ2 以平衡准确性与简洁性；假定高质量检索，模糊查询或知识源不足时收益下降；隐状态干预需开源权重，闭源 API 场景只能以"提示注入指令 + 多候选采样 + 轻量模型打分选优"近似，存在性能与时延差距。伦理上需注意检索文档中的偏见可能被无缝整合放大，以及信息溯源被淡化后错误内容更具说服力的风险。

title: Sheaf-Laplacian Obstruction and Projection Hardness for Cross-Modal Compatibility on a Modality-Independent Site
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Annals of Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence of Springer Nature
summary: We develop a unified framework for analyzing cross-modal compatibility in learned representations. The core object is a modality-independent neighborhood site on sample indices, equipped with a cellular sheaf of finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces. For a directed modality pair $(a\to b)$, we formalize two complementary incompatibility mechanisms: projection hardness, the minimal complexity within a nested Lipschitz-controlled projection family needed for a single global map to align whitened embeddings; and sheaf-Laplacian obstruction, the minimal spatial variation required by a locally fit field of projection parameters to achieve a target alignment error. The obstruction invariant is implemented via a projection-parameter sheaf whose 0-Laplacian energy exactly matches the smoothness penalty used in sheaf-regularized regression, making the theory directly operational. This separates two distinct failure modes: hardness failure, where no low-complexity global projection exists, and obstruction failure, where local projections exist but cannot be made globally consistent over the semantic neighborhood graph without large parameter variation. We link the sheaf spectral gap to stability of global alignment, derive bounds relating obstruction energy to excess global-map error under mild Lipschitz assumptions, and give explicit constructions showing that compatibility is generally non-transitive. We further define bridging via composed projection families and show, in a concrete ReLU setting, that an intermediate modality can strictly reduce effective hardness even when direct alignment remains infeasible.

The obstruction invariant is implemented via a projection-parameter sheaf whose 0-Laplacian energy exactly matches the smoothness penalty used in sheaf-regularized regression, making the theory directly operational. This separates two distinct failure modes: hardness failure, where no low-complexity global projection exists, and obstruction failure, where local projections exist but cannot be made globally consistent over the semantic neighborhood graph without large parameter variation. We link the sheaf spectral gap to stability of global alignment, derive bounds relating obstruction energy to excess global-map error under mild Lipschitz assumptions, and give explicit constructions showing that compatibility is generally non-transitive. title: Visual Perceptual to Conceptual First-Order Rule Learning Networks
summary: Learning rules plays a crucial role in deep learning, particularly in explainable artificial intelligence and enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. While existing rule learning methods are primarily designed for symbolic data, learning rules from image data without supporting image labels and automatically inventing predicates remains a challenge. In this paper, we tackle these inductive rule learning problems from images with a framework called γILP, which provides a fully differentiable pipeline from image constant substitution to rule structure induction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that γILP achieves strong performance not only on classical symbolic relational datasets but also on relational image data and pure image datasets, such as Kandinsky patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出γILP框架，解决从图像数据中无需标签自动学习归纳规则的问题，采用全可微分 pipeline 结合图像常量替换与规则结构归纳，在符号关系数据集、关系图像数据集和纯图像数据集（如 Kandinsky patterns）上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有规则学习方法主要针对符号数据设计，而从图像数据中学习规则、且无需图像标签支持、并能自动发明谓词仍是一项挑战。
AI.method: 提出 γILP 框架，提供从图像常量替换到规则结构归纳的全可微分 pipeline。
AI.result: γILP 在多种数据集上展现出强劲性能，包括经典符号关系数据集、关系图像数据和 Kandinsky patterns 等纯图像数据集。
AI.conclusion: γILP 成功实现了无需标签的图像规则学习，为深度学习的可解释性和大语言模型推理能力增强提供了新思路。

title: Efficient Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography via Range Coding
summary: Linguistic steganography involves embedding secret messages within seemingly innocuous texts to enable covert communication. Provable security, which is a long-standing goal and key motivation, has been extended to language-model-based steganography. Previous provably secure approaches have achieved perfect imperceptibility, measured by zero Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, but at the expense of embedding capacity. In this paper, we attempt to directly use a classic entropy coding method (range coding) to achieve secure steganography, and then propose an efficient and provably secure linguistic steganographic method with a rotation mechanism. Experiments across various language models show that our method achieves around 100% entropy utilization (embedding efficiency) for embedding capacity, outperforming the existing baseline methods. Moreover, it achieves high embedding speeds (up to 1554.66 bits/s on GPT-2). The code is available at github.com/ryehr/RRC_steganography.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于经典熵编码方法（区间编码）的语言隐写术，通过旋转机制实现高效且可证明安全的隐写。在多种语言模型上的实验表明，该方法达到了约100%的熵利用率（嵌入效率），嵌入速度高达1554.66 bits/s，优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 语言隐写术旨在将秘密信息嵌入普通文本中实现隐蔽通信。可证明安全性是该领域长期追求的目标。现有可证明安全的隐写方法虽能达到完美不可感知性（零KL散度），但以牺牲嵌入容量为代价。如何在保证安全性的同时提升嵌入容量和效率是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 直接使用经典熵编码方法——区间编码（range coding）实现安全隐写，并提出带有旋转机制的高效可证明安全语言隐写方法。该方法利用旋转机制优化编码效率。
AI.result: 在多种语言模型上的实验结果表明：(1) 嵌入容量达到约100%熵利用率（嵌入效率）；(2) 嵌入速度高达1554.66 bits/s（基于GPT-2）；(3) 性能优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了安全性与嵌入容量的平衡，为语言隐写术提供了一种高效且可证明安全的实用方案。

title: Cognitive-Causal Multi-Task Learning with Psychological State Conditioning for Assistive Driving Perception
summary: Multi-task learning for advanced driver assistance systems requires modeling the complex interplay between driver internal states and external traffic environments. However, existing methods treat recognition tasks as flat and independent objectives, failing to exploit the cognitive causal structure underlying driving behavior. In this paper, we propose CauPsi, a cognitive science-grounded causal multi-task learning framework that explicitly models the hierarchical dependencies among Traffic Context Recognition (TCR), Vehicle Context Recognition (VCR), Driver Emotion Recognition (DER), and Driver Behavior Recognition (DBR). The proposed framework introduces two key mechanisms. First, a Causal Task Chain propagates upstream task predictions to downstream tasks via learnable prototype embeddings, realizing the cognitive cascade from environmental perception to behavioral regulation in a differentiable manner. Second, Cross-Task Psychological Conditioning (CTPC) estimates a psychological state signal from driver facial expressions and body posture and injects it as a conditioning input to all tasks including environmental recognition, thereby modeling the modulatory effect of driver internal states on cognitive and decision-making processes. Evaluated on the AIDE dataset, CauPsi achieves a mean accuracy of 82.71% with only 5.05M parameters, surpassing prior work by +1.0% overall, with notable improvements on DER (+3.65%) and DBR (+7.53%). Ablation studies validate the independent contribution of each component, and analysis of the psychological state signal confirms that it acquires systematic task-label-dependent patterns in a self-supervised manner without explicit psychological annotations.

title: Capture-Quiet Decomposition: A Verification Theorem for Chess Endgame Tablebases
comment: 9 pages, 3 tables. Validated on 517 endgames covering 6.5 billion positions
summary: We present the Capture-Quiet Decomposition (CQD), a structural theorem for verifying Win-Draw-Loss (WDL) labelings of chess endgame tablebases. The theorem decomposes every legal position into exactly one of three categories -- terminal, capture, or quiet -- and shows that a WDL labeling is correct if and only if: (1) terminal positions are labeled correctly, (2) capture positions are consistent with verified sub-models of smaller piece count, and (3) quiet positions satisfy retrograde consistency within the same endgame. The key insight is that capture positions anchor the labeling to externally verified sub-models, breaking the circularity that allows trivial fixpoints (such as the all-draw labeling) to satisfy self-consistency alone. We validate CQD exhaustively on all 35 three- and four-piece endgames (42 million positions), all 110 five-piece endgames, and all 372 six-piece endgames -- 517 endgames in total -- with the decomposed verifier producing identical violation counts to a full retrograde baseline in every case.

title: Dual-Pool Token-Budget Routing for Cost-Efficient and Reliable LLM Serving
summary: Production vLLM fleets typically provision each instance for the worst-case context length, leading to substantial KV-cache over-allocation and under-utilized concurrency. In practice, 80-95% of requests are short, yet are served under configurations optimized for long contexts, wasting 4-8$\times$ throughput capacity and triggering reliability issues such as OOM crashes, preemption, and request rejections. We identify a common root cause for these inefficiencies: configuration-traffic mismatch. We propose dual-pool token-budget routing, a lightweight dispatch mechanism that partitions a homogeneous fleet into two specialized pools: a high-throughput short-context pool and a high-capacity long-context pool. Each request is routed based on its estimated total token budget, computed using a per-category bytes-to-token ratio that is learned online via exponential moving average from usage.prompt_tokens feedback, eliminating the need for a tokenizer. We also develop a simple analytical model that predicts fleet-level cost savings from workload characteristics and measured throughput differences, enabling practitioners to estimate benefits prior to deployment. Evaluations on real-world traces from the Azure LLM Inference Dataset and LMSYS-Chat-1M, serving Llama-3-70B on A100 GPUs, show that our approach reduces GPU-hours by 31-42%, corresponding to \$2.86M annual savings at fleet scale, while lowering preemption rates by 5.4$\times$ and improving P99 TTFT by 6%. A case study with Qwen3-235B-A22B on AMD MI300X at 10,000 req/s projects \$15.4M in annual savings. The method incurs only O(1) dispatch overhead, adapts automatically to heterogeneous workloads, and composes seamlessly with existing optimizations such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, and prefill-decode disaggregation.

title: Guardian-as-an-Advisor: Advancing Next-Generation Guardian Models for Trustworthy LLMs
summary: Hard-gated safety checkers often over-refuse and misalign with a vendor's model spec; prevailing taxonomies also neglect robustness and honesty, yielding safer-on-paper yet less useful systems. This work introduces Guardian-as-an-Advisor (GaaA), a soft-gating pipeline where a guardian predicts a binary risk label plus a concise explanation and prepends this advice to the original query for re-inference, keeping the base model operating under its original spec. To support training and evaluation, GuardSet is constructed, a 208k+ multi-domain dataset unifying harmful and harmless cases with targeted robustness and honesty slices. GuardAdvisor is trained via SFT followed by RL to enforce label-explanation consistency. GuardAdvisor attains competitive detection accuracy while enabling the advisory workflow; when used to augment inputs, responses improve over unaugmented prompts. A latency study shows advisor inference uses below 5% of base-model compute and adds only 2-10% end-to-end overhead under realistic harmful-input rates. Overall, GaaA steers models to comply with the model spec, maintaining safety while reducing over-refusal.

title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized complex problem-solving, yet they exhibit a pervasive "overthinking", generating unnecessarily long reasoning chains. While current solutions improve token efficiency, they often sacrifice fine-grained control or risk disrupting the logical integrity of the reasoning process. To address this, we introduce Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT), a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure. SAT formulates reasoning as a Finite-State Machine (FSM) with distinct thinking modes (Slow, Normal, Fast, Skip). It navigates these states dynamically using a lightweight Process Reward Model (PRM), compressing easy steps while preserving depth for hard ones. Experiments across 9 LRMs and 7 benchmarks show that SAT achieves up to 40% reduction in reasoning tokens while generally maintaining or improving accuracy.

title: Quantum Vision Theory Applied to Audio Classification for Deepfake Speech Detection
summary: We propose Quantum Vision (QV) theory as a new perspective for deep learning-based audio classification, applied to deepfake speech detection. Inspired by particle-wave duality in quantum physics, QV theory is based on the idea that data can be represented not only in its observable, collapsed form, but also as information waves. In conventional deep learning, models are trained directly on these collapsed representations, such as images. In QV theory, inputs are first transformed into information waves using a QV block, and then fed into deep learning models for classification. QV-based models improve performance in image classification compared to their non-QV counterparts. What if QV theory is applied speech spectrograms for audio classification tasks? This is the motivation and novelty of the proposed approach. In this work, Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), Mel-spectrograms, and Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) of speech signals are converted into information waves using the proposed QV block and used to train QV-based Convolutional Neural Networks (QV-CNN) and QV-based Vision Transformers (QV-ViT). Extensive experiments are conducted on the ASVSpoof dataset for deepfake speech classification. The results show that QV-CNN and QV-ViT consistently outperform standard CNN and ViT models, achieving higher classification accuracy and improved robustness in distinguishing genuine and spoofed speech. Moreover, the QV-CNN model using MFCC features achieves the best overall performance on the ASVspoof dataset, with an accuracy of 94.20% and an EER of 9.04%, while the QV-CNN with Mel-spectrograms attains the highest accuracy of 94.57%. These findings demonstrate that QV theory is an effective and promising approach for audio deepfake detection and opens new directions for quantum-inspired learning in audio perception tasks.

title: Optimal Decay Spectra for Linear Recurrences
summary: Linear recurrent models offer linear-time sequence processing but often suffer from suboptimal long-range memory. We trace this to the decay spectrum: for $N$ channels, random initialization collapses the minimum spectral gap to $O(N^{-2})$, yielding sub-exponential error $\exp(-Ω(N/\log N))$; linear spacing avoids collapse but degrades to $\exp(-O(N/\sqrt{T}))$, practically algebraic over long contexts. We introduce Position-Adaptive Spectral Tapering (PoST), an architecture-agnostic framework combining two mechanisms: (1) Spectral Reparameterization, which structurally enforces geometrically spaced log-decay rates, proven minimax optimal at rate $O(\exp(-cN/\log T))$; and (2) Position-Adaptive Scaling, the provably unique mechanism that eliminates the scale mismatch of static spectra (where only $N\log t/\log T$ of $N$ channels are effective at position $t$) by stretching the spectrum to the actual dependency range, sharpening the rate to $O(\exp(-cN/\log t))$. This scaling natively induces fractional invariance: the impulse response becomes scale-free, with channels interpolating between relative and absolute temporal coordinates. PoST integrates into any diagonal linear recurrence without overhead. We instantiate it across Mamba-2, RWKV-7, Gated DeltaNet, Gated Linear Attention, and RetNet. Pre-training at 180M-440M scales shows consistent zero-shot language modeling improvements, significant long-context retrieval gains for Mamba-2 (MQAR and NIAH), and competitive or improved performance across other architectures. Code: https://github.com/SiLifen/PoST.

AI.tldr: PoST通过谱重参数化和位置自适应缩放两个机制，解决了线性递归模型中因谱隙塌缩导致的次优长程记忆问题，在多个架构和规模上验证了理论结果的有效性。
AI.motivation: 线性递归模型虽可线性时间处理序列，但长程记忆能力不足。根源在于衰减谱：随机初始化时最小谱隙塌缩至O(N⁻²)，导致次指数误差；线性间隔虽避免塌缩但退化至指数形式exp(-O(N/√T))，在长上下文上实际表现为代数衰减。
AI.method:
提出Position-Adaptive Spectral Tapering (PoST)框架，包含两个机制：
1. 谱重参数化(Spectral Reparameterization)：结构化强制几何间隔的对数衰减率，理论证明可达O(exp(-cN/log T))的极小极大最优速率；
2. 位置自适应缩放(Position-Adaptive Scaling)：消除静态谱中只N log t/log T个通道有效的尺度失配，将速率锐化为O(exp(-cN/log t))，诱导分数不变性使冲激响应尺度自由化。
AI.result: 理论：达到O(exp(-cN/log t))的衰减速率；实践：在Mamba-2、RWKV-7、Gated DeltaNet、GLA、RetNet上验证；预训练规模180M-440M参数显示零样本语言建模一致提升，长程检索(MQAR/NIAH)显著改进。
AI.conclusion: PoST作为架构无关的即插即用方案，无需额外计算开销即可提升线性递归模型的长程建模能力，在多种架构和任务上验证了理论保证的有效性。

title: EigentSearch-Q+: Enhancing Deep Research Agents with Structured Reasoning Tools
summary: Deep research requires reasoning over web evidence to answer open-ended questions, and it is a core capability for AI agents. Yet many deep research agents still rely on implicit, unstructured search behavior that causes redundant exploration and brittle evidence aggregation. Motivated by Anthropic's "think" tool paradigm and insights from the information-retrieval literature, we introduce Q+, a set of query and evidence processing tools that make web search more deliberate by guiding query planning, monitoring search progress, and extracting evidence from long web snapshots. We integrate Q+ into the browser sub-agent of Eigent, an open-source, production-ready multi-agent workforce for computer use, yielding EigentSearch-Q+. Across four benchmarks (SimpleQA-Verified, FRAMES, WebWalkerQA, and X-Bench DeepSearch), Q+ improves Eigent's browser agent benchmark-size-weighted average accuracy by 3.0, 3.8, and 0.6 percentage points (pp) for GPT-4.1, GPT-5.1, and Minimax M2.5 model backends, respectively. Case studies further suggest that EigentSearch-Q+ produces more coherent tool-calling trajectories by making search progress and evidence handling explicit.
